episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki's battle reaches its conclusion.

episodes.title: Reality of the Despair, the Assassin's Dagger is Swung
episodes.overview: A conspiracy connecting several recent events in Soul Society is revealed.

episodes.title: Aizen Stands! Horrible Ambitions
episodes.overview: 4th Division Lieutenant Isane Kotetsu informs the Gotei 13 that Sōsuke Aizen is alive as the latter reveals his machinations.

episodes.title: Gather Together! Group of the Strongest Shinigami!
episodes.overview: 5th Division Captain Sōsuke Aizen removes the Hōgyoku from Rukia Kuchiki's Soul and retreats to Hueco Mundo.

episodes.title: Rukia's Resolution, Ichigo's Feelings
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends say their goodbyes in Soul Society before heading back home through the Dangai.

episodes.title: New School Term, Renji Has Come to the Material World?!
episodes.overview: As the lives of Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends begin to return to normal, three mysterious figures appear and abduct Orihime Inoue.

episodes.title: Creeping Terror, the Second Victim
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki, Uryū Ishida, Yasutora Sado, and 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai are forced to play a game in order to find Orihime Inoue.

episodes.title: Breakthrough! The Trap Hidden in the Labyrinth
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki, Lieutenant Renji Abarai, and Uryū Ishida must navigate a labyrinth in order to free their friends.

episodes.title: Death Game! The Missing Classmate
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends must deduce the identity of an impostor in their midst.

episodes.title: True Identity of the Devil, the Secret which Is Revealed
episodes.overview: The truth about the Mod-Souls is revealed as a new enemy appears.

episodes.title: Bount! The Ones Who Hunt Souls
episodes.overview: The Mod-Souls receive new bodies as Ichigo Kurosaki encounters a Bount for the first time.

episodes.title: Rukia's Return! Revival of the Substitute Team!
episodes.overview: Two new Bount appear as one takes an interest in Uryū Ishida.

episodes.title: The Moment of Collision! An Evil Hand Draws Near to the Quincy
episodes.overview: With Ryō Utagawa attempting to devour his Soul, Uryū Ishida finds himself abducted and saved by Yoshino Sōma.

episodes.title: Water Attack! Escape from the Shutdown Hospital
episodes.overview: While Uryū Ishida is in the hospital, his friends must fight two Bount who can control water.

episodes.title: Gathering Bounts! The Man Who Makes His Move
episodes.overview: Ganju Shiba and 4th Division 7th Seat Hanatarō Yamada help conclude the fight against Hō and Ban.

episodes.title: Memories of an Eternally Living Clan
episodes.overview: Uryū Ishida gets to know Yoshino Sōma while 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki and his lieutenant, Yachiru Kusajishi, discover that a former member of their division is in Karakura Town.

episodes.title: Earth-Shattering Event at 11th Squad! The Shinigami Who Rises Again
episodes.overview: 12th Division Captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi informs the Gotei 13 of his missing data on the Bount while Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends break into the Bount Mansion to save Uryū Ishida.

episodes.title: Crashing Force! Fried vs. Zangetsu
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki faces off against Ryō Utagawa, who ends up betraying Jin Kariya with the intention of dethroning him.

episodes.title: Unfading Grudge! The Shinigami whom Kenpachi Killed
episodes.overview: Maki Ichinose remembers his past as he and Jin Kariya battle Ichigo Kurosaki.

episodes.title: Shocking Revelations for the 13 Divisions!! The Truth Buried in History
episodes.overview: Uryū Ishida tries to understand more about Yoshino Sōma as Ichigo Kurosaki spars with 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai and Ganju Shiba in order to regain his fighting spirit.

episodes.title: Yoshino's Decision of Death
episodes.overview: Yoshino Sōma makes a final stand against Jin Kariya in order to redeem herself.

episodes.title: Assault from a Formidable Enemy! A Tiny Final Line of Defense?!
episodes.overview: At Kisuke Urahara's request, Ririn, Kurōdo, and Noba prepare anti-Bount traps around the Kurosaki Clinic, but are angered when Ichigo Kurosaki brushes them off as pointless and unhelpful.

episodes.title: Hitsugaya Moves! The Attacked City
episodes.overview: The Bitto' attack Karakura Town, allowing the Bount to grow stronger, while 10th Division Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya briefs his strike force on their mission in Soul Society.

episodes.title: Ichigo vs. Dalk! Appearance of the Faded Darkness
episodes.overview: 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai fights off the Bitto, who are quickly recalled, while Ichigo Kurosaki battles Gō Koga's Doll, Dalk, in her new form.

episodes.title: Grey Shadow, the Secret of the Dolls
episodes.overview: Gō Koga tells Ichigo Kurosaki that he reminds him of a boy from his past, Cain, whom Koga was assigned to train by Jin Kariya until tragedy struck.

episodes.title: Dissension in the Substitute Team? Rukia's Betrayal
episodes.overview: 3rd Division Lieutenant Izuru Kira fends off Gō Koga's Doll, Dalk, while Mabashi arrives to take over for a struggling Yoshi.

episodes.title: Deadly Battle of Tears! Rukia vs. Orihime
episodes.overview: Mabashi uses his Doll, Ritz, to take control of Rukia Kuchiki's body and force her to fight her friends.

episodes.title: Rangiku Dances! Slice the Invisible Enemy!
episodes.overview: Lieutenant Rangiku Matsumoto, Yasutora Sado, Noba, and Ururu Tsumugiya face off against the old Bount, Sawatari, and his Doll, Baura.

episodes.title: Byakuya is summoned! The Gotei 13 start to move!
episodes.overview: Sawatari retreats while an invisible intruder enters Soul Society. Uryū Ishida remembers training to become a Quincy.

episodes.title: Annihilation of the Lieutenants!? Trap in the Underground Cave
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and company head off to the Bounts' cave, only to encounter Ugaki's Doll, Gesell.

episodes.title: Rematch?! Ishida vs. Nemu
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and friends continue to fight Gesell as Lieutenant Nemu Kurotsuchi presents Uryū Ishida with a battle accessory.

episodes.title: Renji Abarai, Bankai of the Soul!
episodes.overview: Gesell turns on its master. Ichigo Kurosaki attempts to fight Jin Kariya with little success.

episodes.title: Shinigami and Quincy, the Reviving Power
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki initiates Bankai, but Uryū Ishida completes the Bounts' portal, allowing them to enter Soul Society.

episodes.title: Invasion of the Shinigami World, Again
episodes.overview: The Bounts arrive in Soul Society. Rukia Kuchiki meets up with Yoshi once more.

episodes.title: The Bount Assault! The Gotei 13 of Destructive Earthquake
episodes.overview: Rukia Kuchiki squares off against Yoshi. Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto informs the other captains of the Bounts' origins.

episodes.title: Hitsugaya's Decision! The Clash Approaches
episodes.overview: Jin Kariya recruits men from Kusajishi as Ichigo Kurosaki and friends finally arrive at Kūkaku Shiba's house.

episodes.title: Byakuya Takes the Field! Dance of the Wind-Splitting Cherry Blossoms
episodes.overview: Captain Byakuya Kuchiki battles Jin Kariya when Ichigo Kurosaki shows up to help.

episodes.title: Ichigo, Byakuya, Kariya, The Battle of the Three Extremes!
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki and Captain Byakuya Kuchiki continue to fight a continuously healing Jin Kariya, Ran'Tao shows up, prompting Kariya to leave.

episodes.title: Hitsugaya Strikes! Slice the Enemy in the Middle of the Forest
episodes.overview: Ran'Tao reveals the reason for her resemblance to Yoshino Sōma as Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya faces off against Maki Ichinose.

episodes.title: Clash! Kenpachi Zaraki vs. Maki Ichinose
episodes.overview: Captain Kenpachi Zaraki arrives to stop Maki Ichinose.

episodes.title: Shinigami vs. Shinigami! The Uncontrollable Power
episodes.overview: The Bounts break into Seireitei and Captain Suì-Fēng encounters Mabashi.

episodes.title: Suì-Fēng Dies? The Last of the Special Forces
episodes.overview: Captain Suì-Fēng survives her poisoning by using her own poison to nullify Mabashi's, and kills Mabashi.

episodes.title: Mayuri's Bankai!! Sawatari: Clash of the Demon
episodes.overview: Captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi, of the 12th Division, battles against the Bount, Sawatari.

episodes.title: The Last Quincy! The Exploding Power
episodes.overview: As Jin Kariya looks for the Jokai Crest, Uryū Ishida battles the Bount, Yoshi.

episodes.title: Ishida, Exceeding the Limits to Attack!
episodes.overview: As Uryū Ishida defeats the Bount, Yoshi, Jin Kariya prepares to destroy the Soul Society.

episodes.title: 10th Division's Death Struggle! The Release of Hyōrinmaru
episodes.overview: 10th Division Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya battles against the Bount, Gō Koga.

episodes.title: Kariya! Countdown to the Detonation
episodes.overview: As the Shinigami learn more about the Jōkaishō, Ran'Tao confronts Jin Kariya.

episodes.title: Life and Revenge! Ishida, the Ultimate Choice
episodes.overview: Uryū Ishida confronts the Bount, Jin Kariya.

episodes.title: The Swung-Down Edge! The Moment of Ruin
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki and Jin Kariya battle each other, the Shinigami look for the other Jōkaishō to re-seal them.

episodes.title: The Wailing Bount! The Last Clash
episodes.overview: The battle between Ichigo Kurosaki and Jin Kariya concludes.

episodes.title: Ichigo and Rukia, Thoughts in the Revolving Around Heaven
episodes.overview: Following the battle with the Bounts, things slowly return to normal.

episodes.title: Reopening of the Substitute Business! The Terrifying Transfer Student
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki goes back to slaying Hollows in the Human World, but he is soon confronted by Shinji Hirako - a Visored.

episodes.title: Shock! The Father's True Identity
episodes.overview: Isshin Kurosaki reveals himself as a Shinigami and fights Grand Fisher.

episodes.title: The Commencement of War, Vizards and the Arrancars
episodes.overview: Information on the Visored and Arrancar is revealed.

episodes.title: Prelude to the Apocalypse, The Arrancar's Offensive
episodes.overview: Arrancar arrive in the Human World.

episodes.title: Reunion, Ichigo and Rukia and Soul Reapers
episodes.overview: The Arrancar leave the Human World while the Gotei 13 send help to protect the Human World.

episodes.title: Mission! The Soul Reapers Have Come
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki regains his confidence to fight again. Later, more facts about the Arrancar are revealed.

episodes.title: The Evil Eye, Aizen Returns
episodes.overview: The Arrancar arrive in the Human World, again.

episodes.title: Rukia's Battle Commences! The Freezing White Blade
episodes.overview: Rukia Kuchiki battles against the Arrancar, Di Roy Rinker.

episodes.title: Ikkaku's Bankai! The Power That Breaks Everything
episodes.overview: 3rd Seat Ikkaku Madarame battles against the Arrancar, Edrad Liones.

episodes.title: Zaraki Division's Secret Story! The Lucky Men
episodes.overview: 3rd Seat Ikkaku Madarame recalls when he joined the 11th Division.

episodes.title: Hitsugaya Scatters! The Broken Hyōrinmaru
episodes.overview: The battles with the Arrancar continue.

episodes.title: Clash! The Protector vs. The Bearer
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez battle each other.

episodes.title: Vizard! The Power of the Awakened
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki goes to where the Visored are in hopes of learning how to control his Hollowfication.

episodes.title: Ichigo, Complete Hollowification!?
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki begins training to control his Hollowfication.

episodes.title: Collision! Black Bankai and the White Bankai
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki continues his battle with his inner Hollow.

episodes.title: Urgent Report! Aizen's Terrifying Plan!
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki successfully controls his Hollow, Sōsuke Aizen's plans are revealed.

episodes.title: Uryū vs. Ryūken! Clash of the Parent-Child Quincys
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki is informed of Sōsuke Aizen's plans, Uryū Ishida finishes his training.

episodes.title: Urahara's Decision, Orihime's Thoughts
episodes.overview: Orihime Inoue is told that she won't be allowed to fight in the upcoming battles.

episodes.title: The Nightmare Arrancar! Team Hitsugaya Moves Out
episodes.overview: The Shinigami in the Human World find a boy named Shōta Toyokawa.

episodes.title: The Swooping Descent of the Dark Emissary! The Propagation of Malice
episodes.overview: The Shinigami help out Shōta Toyokawa and Yui Toyokawa.

episodes.title: The Invisible Enemy! Hitsugaya's Merciless Decision
episodes.overview: The Shinigami look for the Cloning Arrancar.

episodes.title: Rangiku's Tears, the Sorrowful Parting of Brother and Sister
episodes.overview: The Shinigami face off against the Cloning Arrancar.

episodes.title: Hitsugaya, Karin, and Soccer Ball
episodes.overview: Karin Kurosaki tries to get Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya to help her win an upcoming soccer match.

episodes.title: Ikkaku: The Hot-Blooded Kendo Tale
episodes.overview: 3rd Seat Ikkaku Madarame helps a school student named Shinji Iijima win a Kendō tournament.

episodes.title: The Beautiful Patissier, Yumichika!
episodes.overview: 5th Seat Yumichika Ayasegawa helps a Plus named Heita Momoyama bake a cake for his mother.

episodes.title: Kon is Deceived! Rangiku on the Lookout...
episodes.overview: Kon is forced to live with a girl named Miyuki.

episodes.title: Civil War in Hueco Mundo! Ulquiorra's Death
episodes.overview: Several Arrancar betray Sōsuke Aizen and steal the Hōgyoku.

episodes.title: The Malicious Battle, Aizen's Trap
episodes.overview: The rogue Arrancar are defeated by the Shinigami.

episodes.title: Hueco Mundo moves again! Hitsugaya vs. Yammy
episodes.overview: Several Arrancar head into the Human World.

episodes.title: Ichigo vs. Grimmjow, the 11-second battle!
episodes.overview: As the battles with the Arrancar continue, Ichigo Kurosaki shows off his new power.

episodes.title: Ulquiorra's Scheme, the Moment when the Sun Sets!
episodes.overview: The battles conclude as the Arrancar head back into Hueco Mundo.

episodes.title: Goodbye..., Kurosaki!
episodes.overview: Orihime Inoue says goodbye to Ichigo Kurosaki before leaving for Hueco Mundo.

episodes.title: Strict Order! The Forbidden Rescue of Orihime Inoue
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki learns of Orihime Inoue's disappearance and decides to rescue her.

episodes.title: Grimmjow Revived
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki, Uryū Ishida, and Yasutora Sado head to Hueco Mundo.

episodes.title: Ishida and Chad, The Quickening of a New Power
episodes.overview: Uryū Ishida and Yasutora Sado show off their new strength after arriving in Hueco Mundo.

episodes.title: The Espada Gather! Aizen's Royal Assembly
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends head to Las Noches, Sōsuke Aizen holds a meeting with the Espada.

episodes.title: The Name's Nel! The Appearance of a Strange Arrancar
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki meets the Arrancar Nel Tu and a Guardian causes some trouble.

episodes.title: Forest of Menos! Search for the Missing Rukia
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and the others are forced into the Forest of Menos.

episodes.title: Ashido, The Soul Reaper Who Came from the Past
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and the others continue exploring the Forest of Menos.

episodes.title: Through the Crumbling Forest, a Million Menos
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and the others escape the Forest of Menos.

episodes.title: Oath! Back Here Alive Again
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and his group arrive in Las Noches.

episodes.title: The Raging Storm! Encounter with the Dancing Arrancar
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki battles against the Arrancar, Dordoni Alessandro Del Socaccio.

episodes.title: Ichigo Strikes Back! This Is My Bankai
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki concludes his battle with Dordoni Alessandro Del Socaccio.

episodes.title: The Devilish Research! Szayelaporro's Plan
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and the others continue going on through Las Noches.

episodes.title: Rukia and Kaien, the Sorrowful Reunion
episodes.overview: Rukia Kuchiki reunites with her deceased mentor, Kaien Shiba.

episodes.title: Rukia Retaliates! Release the Desperate Kidō
episodes.overview: As Rukia Kuchiki battles Kaien Shiba, she struggles with wondering on whether or not he's truly Kaien.

episodes.title: Ishida & Pesche, the United Attack of Friendship
episodes.overview: Uryū Ishida and Pesche Guatiche battle against Cirucci Sanderwicci.

episodes.title: Ishida's Trump Card, Seele Schneider
episodes.overview: Uryū Ishida battles Cirucci Sanderwicci with a new weapon called Seele Schneider.

episodes.title: Right Arm of the Giant, Left Arm of the Devil
episodes.overview: Yasutora Sado realizes his true power and battles against Gantenbainne Mosqueda.

episodes.title: Yasutora Sado Dies! Orihime's Tears
episodes.overview: Yasutora Sado is defeated by Nnoitra Gilga and Lieutenant Renji Abarai is confronted by the Espada Szayelaporro Granz.

episodes.title: Testament, Your Heart is Right Here...
episodes.overview: Rukia Kuchiki recalls her past with Kaien Shiba before she kills Aaroniero Arruruerie.

episodes.title: The Cruel Arrancar, Ulquiorra's Provocation
episodes.overview: As the Espada react to the death of Aaroniero Arruruerie, Ichigo Kurosaki is confronted by Ulquiorra Cifer.

episodes.title: Szayelaporro Laughs, The Net Trapping Renji is Complete
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki battles Ulquiorra Cifer, Lieutenant Renji Abarai struggles with his fight against Szayelaporro Granz.

episodes.title: Shinigami and Quincy, The Battle with Madness
episodes.overview: As Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez saves Orihime Inoue from Loly Aivirrne and Menoly Mallia, Uryū Ishida joins Lieutenant Renji Abarai's battle against Szayelaporro Granz.

episodes.title: Ishida's Strategy, 20-Second Offense and Defense
episodes.overview: While Uryū Ishida and Lieutenant Renji Abarai continue their battle against Szayelaporro Granz, Ichigo Kurosaki is healed by Orihime Inoue.

episodes.title: The Murderous Intent Boils! The Joyful Grimmjow
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki begins his final battle with Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez.

episodes.title: Desperate Effort vs. Desperate Effort! Hollowfied Ichigo
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki continues his battle with Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez, Orihime Inoue struggles dealing with Ichigo's Hollowfication form.

episodes.title: The Moment of Conclusion, The End of Grimmjow
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez conclude their battle.

episodes.title: The New Captain Appears! His Name Is Shūsuke Amagai
episodes.overview: Shūsuke Amagai is appointed as new captain of the 3rd Division.

episodes.title: New Development, the Dangerous Transfer Student Appears!
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki meets Rurichiyo Kasumiōji and her two Shinigami guards in the Human World.

episodes.title: Desperate Struggle Under the Moonlit Night, the Mysterious Assassin and Zanpakutō
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki learns more about Rurichiyo Kasumiōji, he is forced to fight off an assassin going after the girl.

episodes.title: Kenryū, the Profusion of Blooming Crimson Flowers
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki is forced to take care of Rurichiyo Kasumiōji, another assassin attempts to kill her.

episodes.title: Kibune Goes to War! The Violent Wind that Rages
episodes.overview: Izuru Kira begins to get depressed over the fact that the 3rd Division members like Makoto Kibune more than him.

episodes.title: The Appearance of the Great Evil! The Darkness in the House of Kasumiōji
episodes.overview: Rurichiyo Kasumiōji is targeted by more assassins after secretly returning to the Soul Society.

episodes.title: Break the Mirror's Boundary! Ichigo's Captivity
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki faces off against the assassin Hanza Nukui.

episodes.title: The Revenging Assassin, Ichigo is Targeted
episodes.overview: Hanza Nukui and his subordinates attack the Human World to kill Ichigo Kurosaki and Rurichiyo Kasumiōji.

episodes.title: Mystery! The Sword-Consuming Assassin
episodes.overview: The fights with the assassins continue.

episodes.title: The Reversal of Rukia! The Rampaging Blade
episodes.overview: Rukia Kuchiki, Uryū Ishida, and Yasutora Sado finish their battles against the assassins.

episodes.title: The Nightmare Which is Shown, Ichigo's Inside the Mirror
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki finishes his battle with Hanza Nukui.

episodes.title: Confrontation!? Amagai vs. Gotei 13
episodes.overview: Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto orchestrates a Menos Grande attack on Soul Society to help him decide on Captain Shūsuke Amagai's proposal to have joint training between the Divisions.

episodes.title: The Princess's Decision, the Sorrowful Bride
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki heads to the Soul Society to stop Rurichiyo Kasumiōji's wedding.

episodes.title: The 2nd Division Sorties! Ichigo is Surrounded
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki try to stop Rurichiyo Kasumiōji's wedding, but they end up getting attacked by the Gotei 13 in the process.

episodes.title: Amagai's True Strength, the Released Zanpakuto!
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki looks for Rurichiyo Kasumiōji, he is confronted by Captain Shūsuke Amagai.

episodes.title: The Darkness Which Moves! Kibune's True Colors
episodes.overview: Lieutenant Izuru Kira and Makoto Kibune face off against each other.

episodes.title: Kira and Kibune, Offense and Defense of the 3rd Division
episodes.overview: Lieutenant Izuru Kira and Makoto Kibune continue their battle.

episodes.title: Ice and Flame! Fierce Fight of Amagai vs. Hitsugaya
episodes.overview: As Lieutenant Izuru Kira concludes his battle with Makoto Kibune, Captain Shūsuke Amagai is forced to battle against Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya.

episodes.title: Sortie Orders! Suppress the House of Kasumiōji
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki is able to save Rurichiyo Kasumiōji, but more problems arise when it is revealed that Captain Shūsuke Amagai was working with Gyōkaku Kumoi.

episodes.title: Ichigo Rages! The Assassin's Secret
episodes.overview: Captain Shūsuke Amagai reveals his true intentions to Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto.

episodes.title: Duel! Amagai vs. Ichigo
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and Captain Shūsuke Amagai battle each other.

episodes.title: The Fallen Shinigami's Pride
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and Captain Shūsuke Amagai conclude their battle.

episodes.title: Hueco Mundo Chapter, Restart!
episodes.overview: Following a lengthy recap of the events since Sōsuke Aizen betrayed Soul Society, Ichigo Kurosaki concludes his duel with Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez before being confronted by Nnoitra Gilga.

episodes.title: The Frightening Banquet, Szayelaporro Theater
episodes.overview: Szayelaporro Granz releases his Zanpakutō, while Nnoitra Gilga provides a surprising revelation about the true identity of the Arrancar Nel Tu.

episodes.title: Nel's Secret, A Busty Beauty Joins the Battle!?
episodes.overview: Nel Tu transforms back into her original Espada form.

episodes.title: Irresistible, Puppet Show of Terror
episodes.overview: Szayelaporro Granz demonstrates a new technique, whilst Nnoitra Gilga is taken aback by Nelliel Tu Odelschwanck's onslaught.

episodes.title: Neliel's Past
episodes.overview: Nnoitra Gilga recalls his past with Nelliel Tu Odelschwanck.

episodes.title: The Ultimate Union! Pesche's Seriousness
episodes.overview: Nelliel Tu Odelschwanck returns to her child form, leaving Ichigo Kurosaki in the hands of Tesra Lindocruz. Szayelaporro Granz is seemingly impervious to attack, Zommari Rureaux is about to finish off Rukia Kuchiki, whilst the Exequias plan to execute Yasutora Sado.

episodes.title: Joining the Battle! The Strongest Soul Reaper Army Appears
episodes.overview: The Gotei 13 come to the rescue of Ichigo Kurosaki and his comrades.

episodes.title: Byakuya's Bankai, The Quiet Anger
episodes.overview: Zommari Rureaux releases his Zanpakutō, forcing Captain Byakuya Kuchiki to take drastic action to avoid defeat.

episodes.title: The Two Scientists, Mayuri's Trap
episodes.overview: Captain Byakuya Kuchiki finishes off Zommari Rureaux, while Captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi gains the upper hand against Szayelaporro Granz.

episodes.title: Holy Birth, The Resurrected Szayel Aporro
episodes.overview: Captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi decides to end his battle against a reborn Szayelaporro Granz.

episodes.title: The Hardest Body!? Cut Down Nnoitra
episodes.overview: Captain Kenpachi Zaraki and Nnoitra Gilga continue their brawling.

episodes.title: Nnoitra Released! Multiplying Arms
episodes.overview: The battle between Captain Kenpachi Zaraki and Nnoitra Gilga becomes more fierce as Nnoitra releases his Zanpakutō.

episodes.title: Fierce Fighting Conclusion! Who's the Strongest?
episodes.overview: Captain Kenpachi Zaraki and Nnoitra Gilga conclude their battle.

episodes.title: Karakura Town Gathers! Aizen Versus the Soul Reapers
episodes.overview: Sōsuke Aizen reveals his plans and heads to Karakura Town.

episodes.title: Ichigo's Seppuku Persuasion Strategy ☆
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki tries to help out a feuding Rurichiyo Kasumiōji and Kenryū.

episodes.title: Thump! A Kemari Tournament Filled with Hollows
episodes.overview: Rurichiyo Kasumiōji and Kenryū have a kemari match.

episodes.title: The Past Chapter Begins! The Truth from 110 Years Ago
episodes.overview: The past of several Shinigami from 110 years ago is revealed.

episodes.title: 12th Division's New Captain, Urahara Kisuke
episodes.overview: The 12th Division deals with Kisuke Urahara being the new captain.

episodes.title: Aizen and the Genius Boy
episodes.overview: Captain Kisuke Urahara takes Lieutenant Hiyori Sarugaki to the Nest of Maggots.

episodes.title: Muguruma 9th Division, Moves Out
episodes.overview: The Gotei 13 attempt to figure what's behind the disappearances of Rukongai citizens.

episodes.title: Hiyori Dies? The Beginning of Tragedy
episodes.overview: Several Gotei 13 captains and lieutenants face off against a Hollowfied Captain Kensei Muguruma and Lieutenant Mashiro Kuna.

episodes.title: Betrayal! Aizen's Secret Maneuvers
episodes.overview: Lieutenant Sōsuke Aizen reveals himself as a traitor.

episodes.title: Rescue Hirako! Aizen vs. Urahara
episodes.overview: Captains Kisuke Urahara, Tessai Tsukabishi, and Yoruichi Shihōin leave to the Human World with the Hollowfied captains and lieutenants.

episodes.title: The Konso Cop Karakuraizer is Born
episodes.overview: Kisuke Urahara creates the Karakura-Raizer Team to protect Karakura Town.

episodes.title: Karakuraizer's Last Day
episodes.overview: The Karakura-Raizer Team face off against a female Arrancar.

episodes.title: Defend Karakura Town! Entire Appearance of the Shinigami
episodes.overview: As the Gotei 13 prepare to face off against the top three Espada, Ichigo Kurosaki confronts Ulquiorra Cifer.

episodes.title: Elite! The Four Shinigami
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki confronts Ulquiorra Cifer, the battle for the four pillars begins in Karakura Town.

episodes.title: Beautiful Little Devil Charlotte
episodes.overview: 5th Seat Yumichika Ayasegawa and Charlotte Chuhlhourne battle each other.

episodes.title: Kira, The Battle Within Despair
episodes.overview: Lieutenant Izuru Kira, Lieutenant Shūhei Hisagi, and 3rd Seat Ikkaku Madarame continue their fights against Baraggan Louisenbairn's Fracción.

episodes.title: Hisagi's Shikai! The Name is...
episodes.overview: Lieutenant Shūhei Hisagi and Findorr Calius battle each other.

episodes.title: Ikkaku Falls! The Shinigami's Crisis
episodes.overview: 3rd Seat Ikkaku Madarame loses his fight against Choe Neng Poww, forcing Captain Sajin Komamura to take over his battle.

episodes.title: The Full Showdown! Soul Reapers vs. Espada
episodes.overview: Captain Suì-Fēng begins her battle with Ggio Vega while the other two Espada and their Fracción begin their fights.

episodes.title: The Most Evil Tag!? Suì-Fēng & Ōmaeda
episodes.overview: Ggio Vega and Nirgge Parduoc release their Zanpakutōs, prompting Lieutenant Marechiyo Ōmaeda to use his true power.

episodes.title: A Miraculous Body! Ggio Releases
episodes.overview: Lieutenant Marechiyo Ōmaeda and Captain Suì-Fēng struggle against their opponents, but are eventually able to win.

episodes.title: 3 vs. 1 Battle! Rangiku's Crisis
episodes.overview: Lieutenant Momo Hinamori arrives to help out Lieutenant Rangiku Matsumoto, prompting Harribel's Fracción to bring forth Ayon.

episodes.title: Vice-Captains Annihilated! The Terrifying Demonic Beast
episodes.overview: Ayon overpowers the lieutenants, greatly injuring them, but Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto appears to fight the beast.

episodes.title: Fierce Fighting Concludes? Towards a New Battle!
episodes.overview: Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto effortlessly finishes Ayon and Harribel's Fracción. Starrk reveals himself to be the Primera Espada. Rukia Kuchiki fights Rudbornn as Ichigo Kurosaki struggles against Ulquiorra Cifer.

episodes.title: Wonderful Error
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and Yasutora Sado become classmates with Mizuiro Kojima and Keigo Asano. Rukia Kuchiki is assigned to Karakura Town and Renji Abarai is promoted.

episodes.title: Summer! Sea! Swimsuit Festival!!
episodes.overview: The characters take a break on the beach.

episodes.title: Cry of the Soul? The Rug Shinigami is Born!
episodes.overview: Ikkaku and Yumichika are forced to stay with Mizuho again while on a mission in the Human World.

episodes.title: A New Enemy! The Materialization of Zanpakutō
episodes.overview: A mysterious Zanpakutō Spirit named Muramasa releases the spirits of many Zanpakutō from their swords and attacks Soul Society.

episodes.title: Byakuya, Disappearing with the Cherry Blossoms
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki battles against the manifested Zanpakutō Spirit of Sode no Shirayuki, who arrives in the Human World while chasing Rukia Kuchiki.

episodes.title: Sode no Shirayuki vs. Rukia! Confused Heart
episodes.overview: Rukia Kuchiki and Ichigo Kurosaki battle Sode no Shirayuki, and Muramasa reveals he is a Zanpakutō Spirit.

episodes.title: Zangetsu Becomes an Enemy
episodes.overview: Muramasa releases Zangetsu, and Ichigo Kurosaki fights him as his inner Hollow begins to take control.

episodes.title: Renji Surprised?! The Two Zabimarus
episodes.overview: 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai is confronted by the spirit of his Zanpakutō, and Muramasa enters Ichigo Kurosaki's inner world.

episodes.title: Clash! Hisagi vs. Kazeshini
episodes.overview: 9th Division Lieutenant Shūhei Hisagi fights his Zanpakutō spirit while Hollow Ichigo fights Muramasa and 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai regains the ability to release his Shikai, Zabimaru.

episodes.title: Release! The New Getsuga Tenshō
episodes.overview: 3rd Division Lieutenant Izuru Kira aids 9th Division Lieutenant Shūhei Hisagi, who is fighting Kazeshini, while 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai and Ichigo Kurosaki conclude their battles.

episodes.title: Suì-Fēng, Surrounding the Zanpakutō
episodes.overview: 11th Division 3rd Seat Ikkaku Madarame and 2nd Division Lieutenant Marechiyo Ōmaeda encounter their Zanpakutō Spirits, and Ichigo Kurosaki spots 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki.

episodes.title: Friendship? Hatred? Haineko & Tobiume
episodes.overview: 10th Division Lieutenant Rangiku Matsumoto and 5th Division Lieutenant Momo Hinamori battle their Zanpakutō Spirits, and 10th Division Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya tells Hyōrinmaru what his name is while Muramasa limps through the Forest of Menos.

episodes.title: The Awakening Hyōrinmaru! Hitsugaya's Fierce Fight
episodes.overview: As 5th Division Lieutenant Momo Hinamori and 10th Division Lieutenant Rangiku Matsumoto conclude their battle, 10th Division Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya tries to convince Hyōrinmaru he is his master, but the Zanpakutō Spirit does not believe it.

episodes.title: Byakuya's Betrayal
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki attacks Muramasa, but Senbonzakura, and later 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki, shows up to protect him.

episodes.title: For the Sake of Pride! Byakuya vs. Renji
episodes.overview: Muramasa has 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki perform a test of loyalty. Afterwards, Byakuya invades the 6th Division barracks and is forced to fight his lieutenant, Renji Abarai.

episodes.title: Shinigami and Zanpakutō, Total Sortie
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki, 2nd Division Captain Suì-Fēng, and 3rd Division Lieutenant Izuru Kira begin their battles, 11th Division 3rd Seat Ikkaku Madarame fights and defeats his Zanpakutō Spirit, Hōzukimaru.

episodes.title: One-to-One Fight! Ichigo vs. Senbonzakura
episodes.overview: As the Shinigami battle the Zanpakutō Spirits, 3rd Division Lieutenant Izuru Kira defeats Kazeshini, only to be attacked by Wabisuke. Meanwhile, 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki arrives at the battlefield.

episodes.title: The Long Awaited... Kenpachi Appears!
episodes.overview: 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki arrives and defeats Wabisuke before moving on to 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki. Meanwhile, 11th Division 5th Seat Yumichika Ayasegawa defeats his manifested Zanpakutō Spirit, Ruri'iro Kujaku.

episodes.title: Pursue Byakuya! The Confused Gotei Divisions
episodes.overview: As 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki and 6th Division Byakuya Kuchiki fight, 11th Division Lieutenant Yachiru Kusajishi chases Ashisogi Jizō before 12th Division Captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi forces his Zanpakutō Spirit to self-destruct and tells others to not interfere. Muramasa takes Byakuya to see Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto, who is inside of a barrier guarded by a dark-haired woman, two white-haired boys, and a cloaked figure.

episodes.title: Special Mission! Rescue Captain Commander Yamamoto!
episodes.overview: A group of Shinigami attempt to rescue Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto, but they are held back by several Zanpakutō Spirits. Meanwhile, Ichigo Kurosaki arrives at the barrier surrounding Yamamoto and prepares to destroy it.

episodes.title: Deceived Shinigami! The World Collapse Crisis
episodes.overview: As Yoruichi Shihōin, 8th Division Captain Shunsui Kyōraku, 11th Division Captain Jūshirō Ukitake, and 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki continue to fight against the Zanpakutō Spirits, Ichigo Kurosaki frees Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto, only to learn this was all part of Muramasa's plan.

episodes.title: Dragon of Ice and Dragon of Flame! The Strongest Showdown!
episodes.overview: Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto and the others are held back by Ryūjin Jakka's flames as Muramasa attempts to free Kōga Kuchiki.

episodes.title: Senbonzakura's Bankai! Offense and Defense of the Living World
episodes.overview: 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki faces off against Tenken's Bankai, Kokujō Tengen Myō'ō, as Muramasa frees his master, Kōga.

episodes.title: That Man, for the Sake of the Kuchiki
episodes.overview: Kōga Kuchiki's past is revealed.

episodes.title: Dark History! The Worst Shinigami Is Born
episodes.overview: 6th Division Captain Ginrei Kuchiki and Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto are forced to seal Kōga Kuchiki away. In the present, 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki stops Kōga from killing Muramasa.

episodes.title: Byakuya, the Truth Behind His Betrayal
episodes.overview: As Senbonzakura reveals the truth about 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki's betrayal, Byakuya fights against Kōga Kuchiki. Meanwhile, Muramasa loses controls and unleashes hundreds of Gillians.

episodes.title: Muramasa's True Identity Revealed
episodes.overview: 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki defeats Kōga Kuchiki as Muramasa loses control and transforms into a Hollow version of himself. As Ichigo Kurosaki battles Muramasa, several Shinigami and their Zanpakutō Spirits arrive to help.

episodes.title: Byakuya and Renji, the 6th Division Returns
episodes.overview: The Shinigami and their Zanpakutō Spirits try to deal with the Gillians.

episodes.title: Final Chapter - Zanpakutō The Alternate Tale
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki defeats Muramasa, and the Zanpakutō Spirits return to their original forms.

episodes.title: The Angered Byakuya! The Collapse of the Kuchiki House
episodes.overview: A party is being held at the Kuchiki Manor when two rogue Zanpakutō Spirits, called Tōjū, attack and disrupt the party.

episodes.title: A New Enemy! The True Nature of the Sword Beasts
episodes.overview: 10th Division Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya battles a Tōjū which has been absorbed by a Hollow.

episodes.title: Stray Snake, Tortured Monkey
episodes.overview: 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai and his Zanpakutō Spirit, Zabimaru, must defeat a Tōjū, but Hebi wants freedom.

episodes.title: Terror! The Monster That Lurks Underground
episodes.overview: A group of Shinigami must go into the sewers to fight a Tōjū. They are aided by a Zanpakutō Spirit who has been living in the sewers.

episodes.title: Conclusion!? Hisagi vs. Kazeshini
episodes.overview: Kazeshini has a change of heart when he is forced to look after a baby.

episodes.title: The Person with the Unknown Ability! Orihime Is Targeted
episodes.overview: Orihime Inoue must help a transfer student who is being controlled by a Tōjū.

episodes.title: Haineko Cries! The Tragic Sword Beast!
episodes.overview: Haineko falls for a Tōjū who is fully aware. However, when he loses control, Haineko decides to defeat him herself.

episodes.title: Imprisonment?! Senbonzakura & Zabimaru
episodes.overview: Zabimaru and Senbonzakura are trapped in the Shinigami Research and Development Institute.

episodes.title: Battle of the Females? Katen Kyōkotsu vs. Nanao!
episodes.overview: 8th Division Lieutenant Nanao Ise tries to relate to the violet-haired girl while they battle a Tōjū.

episodes.title: Evolution?! The Menace of the Final Sword Beast
episodes.overview: The Zanpakutō Spirits struggle with the final Tōjū until their wielders arrive to help.

episodes.title: Ichigo vs. Ulquiorra, Resume
episodes.overview: Prior events are recalled.

episodes.title: Connected Hearts! The Left Fist of Certain Death
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki struggles against Ulquiorra Cifer as Renji Abarai and Yasutora Sado fight Battikaroa.

episodes.title: Hatred and Jealousy, Orihime's Dilemma
episodes.overview: Loly Aivirrne and Menoly Mallia take Orihime Inoue up to where Ichigo Kurosaki is fighting. Yammy Llargo shows up and, after disposing of Loly, is ambushed by Uryū Ishida.

episodes.title: Ichigo and Uryū, Bonded Back to Back
episodes.overview: As Uryū Ishida deals with Yammy Llargo, Ulquiorra Cifer shows Ichigo Kurosaki his Resurrección.

episodes.title: Beginning of Despair... Ichigo, the Unreachable Blade
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki greatly struggles with Ulquiorra Cifer in his released form and to further drive it in, Ulquiorra shows Ichigo his second release.

episodes.title: Ichigo Dies! Orihime, the Cry of Sorrow!
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki's Hollow form completely takes him over, he begins battling Ulquiorra Cifer again.

episodes.title: Ichigo vs. Ulquiorra, Conclusion!
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and Ulquiorra Cifer conclude their battle.

episodes.title: Fury of the Shark! Halibel's Release
episodes.overview: As Rukia Kuchiki, Yasutora Sado, and Lieutenant Renji Abarai battle Yammy Llargo, the captains in the Fake Karakura Town continue battling the Espada.

episodes.title: Hitsugaya, the Desperate Hyōten Hyakkasō!
episodes.overview: The battle between Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya and Tier Harribel continues.

episodes.title: The Approaching Breath of Death, the King Who Rules Over Death!
episodes.overview: Captain Suì-Fēng and Lieutenant Marechiyo Ōmaeda struggle against Baraggan Louisenbairn.

episodes.title: One Hit Kill, Suì-Fēng, Bankai!
episodes.overview: As Lieutenant Marechiyo Ōmaeda distracts Baraggan Luisenbarn for Captain Suì-Fēng, Captain Shunsui Kyōraku and Coyote Starrk continue their battle.

episodes.title: Climax! Kyōraku vs. Stark!
episodes.overview: Captain Shunsui Kyōraku and Coyote Starrk decide to get serious in their battle.

episodes.title: The Nightmare Returns... Revival of the Espada
episodes.overview: The Espada are shown to still be alive, Sōsuke Aizen, Gin Ichimaru, and Kaname Tōsen are freed, and the Visored arrive on the battlefield.

episodes.title: Hirako and Aizen...the Reunion of Fate!
episodes.overview: The Visored join the fight.

episodes.title: Hisagi and Tōsen, the Moment of Parting
episodes.overview: Hachigen Ushōda helps Captain Suì-Fēng battle Baraggan Luisenbarn.

episodes.title: Crown of Lies, Baraggan's Grudge
episodes.overview: Baraggan Luisenbarn recalls his past as the King of Hueco Mundo before dying.

episodes.title: Power of the Soul! Los Lobos, Attack!
episodes.overview: Love Aikawa and Rōjūrō Ōtoribashi battle against Coyote Starrk.

episodes.title: Stark, the Lone Battle
episodes.overview: Coyote Starrk and Captain Shunsui Kyōraku conclude their battle.

episodes.title: Departure x And x Friends
episodes.overview: The story begins with a young boy named Gon, who aspires to be a hunter just like his father Ging. Ging leaves his son in the care of Mito, Gon's aunt, and has not been seen since. Gon catches the local monster fish, "Lord of the Lake", in order to prove his ability to take the exam. Although Mito is reluctant to let Gon leave his home, she relents after he is determined to understand the reason his father left him and his interest of being a hunter.

episodes.title: Test x Of x Tests
episodes.overview: Gon, Kurapika and Leorio reach Dolle Harbor and are given instructions by the captain to head for the cedar tree on the hilltop behind the city. Moving through a small town, the three are stopped by a group of people, where an old woman gives a question requring them to choose from two choices. Answering wrongly, refusing to answer or attempting to head back will result in failure of the exam.

episodes.title: Rivals x For x Survival
episodes.overview: With the navigators' help, Gon, Kurapika and Leorio arrive at Zaban City, the venue of the exam. The navigator leads them to a small restaurant, which is revealed to be the front for the venue. Gon's group is led to an elevator disguised as a back room, which leads a hundred floors underground. Below, they meet the rest of the participants and given their numbers. There they meet Tonpa, a regular participant who claims to have tried and failed 35 times in the exam.

episodes.title: Hope x And x Ambition
episodes.overview: During the first test, a number of participants fall out from fatigue after running for at least forty kilometers. Leorio almost gives up until he is encouraged by Gon, who waits for him. Killua, a participant, is introduced and he is curious of Gon's personality when he discovers that the boy is the same age as him. Kurapika and Leorio talk about the reason for being a hunter, with Kurapika wanting to take down the Phantom Troupe as his clan was massacred by them for their precious scarlet eyes, which manifest when the Kurta uses their heightened sense. Leorio aims to be a hunter for money, for purely altruistic reasons, as his childhood friend died of an illness without the funds to save him. He wishes to be a doctor so he can give his patients free treatment. Finally, the participants reach the end of the tunnel they are in and up to the surface to the Numere Wetlands, also known as Swindlers' Swamp.

episodes.title: Hisoka x Is x Sneaky
episodes.overview: While following Satotz, a fog moves into the swamp and most of the participants are either rendered unconscious or killed by traps and verocious beasts. A group of candidates target Hisoka as they feel he's a threat. Gon and Killua are separated from Leorio and Kurapika and both sides are eventually attacked by monsters. Leorio and Kurapika encounter Hisoka about to be attacked by candidates but are shocked to watch the magician easily take the candidates down. Hisoka then targets Leorio and Kurapika, but realizing that they are no match for him, they decide to head in different directions to stop him from following. However, Leorio returns, unable to run away from a fight. As expected, Leorio is beaten badly by Hisoka. Before the melee can get any worse, Gon, who is separated from Killua, arrives to stop Hisoka. Although he is also no match for Hisoka, he manages to hit his face once before being strangled by Hisoka.

episodes.title: A x Surprising x Challenge
episodes.overview: Gon and Kurapika reunite with Leorio and Killua at the Phase Two site. Satotz leads what remains of the candidates to meet the second phase examiners, named Menchi and Buhara. The examiners declare the next phase is to test their cooking skills, much to the candidates' disbelief. The test requires pork, so the candidates are sent to find pigs in the forest. However, the pigs living inside the forest are carnivorous and tear through the candidates. Thanks to Gon, they discover the pigs' weakness and they manage to each get one for their cooking. Upon tasting the candidates' cooking, Buhara gives a pass but Menchi fails all of them. Knowing the candidates will riot, Satotz informs Chairman Netoros of the Hunter Selection Committee to make an appearance. Netoros arrives to correct Menchi's habit of getting biased whenever it's related to cooking. Netoros allows Menchi to stay on as examiner, and she gives the candidates a retest: boil eggs laid by spider eagles on Mt. Split-in-Half.

episodes.title: Showdown x On The x Airship
episodes.overview: All the candidates are told by Beans, Neteros' secretary to get their dinner and rest and prepare for the third phase the next morning. Tonpa tries to commit sabotage again by trying to keep Kurapika and Leorio awake for the whole night, but is exasperated to find that none of them fall for his tricks. Gon and Killua explore the airship, and Killua tells Gon that he is actually from a family of assassins. He wished to strike out on his own, which his family has not taken lightly. Neteros arrives and tests both boys' instinct and asks how they felt about the difficulty of the exam. Neteros invites both of them to a game, whoever can grab the ball he is holding before dawn will immediately pass the exam. Gon and Killua find it too hard to pass up, but discovers that with Neteros' skills, they are unable to grab the ball. Eventually Killua realizes that with their skills, they will never be able to take the ball from Neteros for a year, if he keeps it up.

episodes.title: Decision x By x Majority?
episodes.overview: The airship reaches Trick Tower, the Phase Three site, which is a tall featureless pillar built on an equally high platform. The candidates are told that to pass Phase 3, they have to climb down from the top to the base of the tower. An experienced rock climber candidate tries to climb down but is eaten by some flying monsters. Later, Kurapika finds that more than half of the candidates have discovered hidden doors to go inside the tower, which Gon finds one as well. However, the catch is that there are many hidden doors, each one can be only used once and only one person can fit through a door, which means they have to split up. When they try out different doors, they realize that they end up in the same room. In the room, Gon's group are given instructions and special wristwatches for five of them to follow the majority, but they cannot proceed without a fifth member. Lippo, one of the Phase 3 examiners tells them this while explaining they have chosen the path of majority rule.

episodes.title: Beware x Of x Prisoners
episodes.overview: Tonpa promptly gives up even before Bendot land a punch on him. Leorio is furious at what he has done but Tonpa tells them that his real plan is to sabotage rookies like them. Gon then faces Sedokan, who proposes a match to see whose candle burns the longest. Gon chooses the longer candle, unaware that it is oil-soaked, and his candle starts to burn faster midway. Seeing that his candle is not susceptible to strong winds, he puts it down and sprints towards Sedokan to blow his candle. The next match is between Kurapika and Majitani, who proposes a death match without weapons and and with the condition that one must die or surrender to finish the match. Majitani, who relies on scaring and intimidating his enemies to make them surrender, is easily defeated by Kurapika when he sees something in Majitani and makes him see red.

episodes.title: Trick x To The x Trick
episodes.overview: A female prisoner claim that Majitani is only unconscious, thus Kurapika's match has not been settled. Leorio, and even Killua cannot persuade Kurapika to finish the fight for the latter refuses to fight a person who has lost the will to fight. Frustrated, Leorio decides to use the majority rule as a way out of the difficulty but no one supports him. Elsewhere Hisoka is met by Togari, a former examiner whom Hisoka attacked and is now wanting revenge. Togari attacks with four crescent blades, only to be finished with one sweeping attack. Hisoka then becomes the first applicant to pass this phase. Meanwhile, the team suspects Majitani's real condition. The female prisoner challenges Leorio to have a betting game instead. Leorio agrees and bets ten hours that Majitani is alive, which he wins. Next, he bets twenty hours on Majitani feigning unconsciousness. To confirm, he brings Majitani to the edge of the platform and threatens to drop him. Seeing that, the prisoner changes her bet to forty hours on Majitani being conscious. When he is about to be dropped by Leorio, Majitani moves and admits defeat, putting the score at 2 - 1 in favor of Leorio's team. However, they only have 20 hours left to wager

episodes.title: Trouble x With The x Gamble
episodes.overview: After winning the bet about Majitani, Leroute, as what the prisoner is named, bets with Leorio about her gender. Despite looking conspicuously female, Leorio, much to Killua and Kurapika's annoyance, bets that she is male. Leorio thinks that team wins if he is correct; and if he is wrong, he will be able to touch Leroute to confirm. Leorio is wrong and goes on to check Leroute. Leorio then challenges Leroute in rock, paper, scissors, and loses. Killua then faces the feared mass murderer Johness the Dissector. Killua rips Johness' heart in an instant and even have it covered in a piece of Johness' cloth. The latter pleads for his heart, and Killua returned it after he is dead. The team thus gathers three points and pass the trial, but they are forced to wait the 50 hours that Leorio has lost with his bets in a small room. Meanwhile, applicants Gittarackur and Hanzo become the second and third one to finish the third phase.

episodes.title: Last x Test Of x Resolve!
episodes.overview: The team stays inside a small room for fifty hours and keep themselves from getting bored. Then they spend the remaining time going to a series of traps and tricks. At the last room, they encountered two doors and are forced to either choose the long and hard path (45 hours) in which all of them may use or the shortcut (about 3 minutes) wherein two of them must be left behind. As disputes break out among them, Gon comes up with an ingenious idea of opening the long way and breaking through the wall to go to the shortcut so all five of them pass this phase.

episodes.title: Letter x From x Gon
episodes.overview: Gon decides to send a letter to his aunt Mito in order to inform her about the events that had happened during his journey. He started to narrate the story on the events starting from the preliminary Hunter exam to the point when he met Leorio, Kurapika, Killua and the other examinees.

episodes.title: Hit x The x Target
episodes.overview: Gon learns to master his accuracy with his pole to try and steal Hisoka's number plate.Finally mastering it,He decides to steal it when Hisoka is busy catching his Prey.

episodes.title: Explosion x Of x Deception!
episodes.overview: Gon is relying on Bloodcrazy Butterflies to find his target, Hisoka, before waiting for the perfect time to use his skill with the fishing rod to snatch Hisoka's tag. Meanwhile, Leorio is tricked by Tonpa and loses his own tag, but Kurapika helps him recover it. Now that Kurapika and Leorio know that neither is the other's target, they decided to form an alliance.

episodes.title: Defeat x And x Disgrace
episodes.overview: Kurapika and Leorio are being stalked by Hisoka, but they managed to negotiate their way out of a fight. However, the encounter leaves Hisoka aroused, so he leaves in search of a new target. Gon is able to use his fishing rod to snatch Hisoka's tag right when Hisoka attacks his target. However, as Gon tries to escape, he is attacked by another applicant and loses his tag...

episodes.title: Trap x In The x Hole
episodes.overview: Killua grows tired of having Imori shadowing him so he challenges Imori to a fight and quickly dispatches him. Meanwhile, Gon has joined up with Leorio and Kurapika. The three of them devise a plan for taking Ponzu's tag and track her down to a suspicious-looking cave. That is when Leorio insists on heading in alone.

episodes.title: Big x Time x Interview
episodes.overview: Gon and his friends have been trapped inside a cave by poisonous snakes. Bourbon, the person responsible for the trap, is already dead, and nobody knows how to disarm the trap. Meanwhile, Leorio, who was bitten by the snakes, is growing weak. Gon manages to get them out of the sticky situation and through to the final phase of the exam. But first, Netero wants an interview with each of the remaining applicants...

episodes.title: Can't Win x and x Can't Lose
episodes.overview: Gon and his friends have advanced to the final phase of the Hunter Exam. The final phase is a tournament where the winners are out and the losers advance. The rule is that if you kill your opponent, you'll be disqualified. The first mach is Gon versus Hanzo. Gon can't do anything against Hanzo, but he refuses to give up. Hanzo is losing his patience and threatens to break Gon's arm.

episodes.title: Baffling x Turn of x Events
episodes.overview: Gon wakes up, and finds himself being congratulated by Satotz for being the first person to pass the Hunter Exam. Gon asks Satotz if the Exam was still going on, and Satotz tells him that it's over. Satotz reveals what happens after he lost consciousness, and Gon finds out some shocking turn of events.

episodes.title: Some x Brother x Trouble
episodes.overview: Gon is upset that Killua was forced to kill. Gon is mad at Illumi and proclaims that he will go to Kukuroo Mountain to rescue Killua. As Gon and his friends depart, Satotz mentions that the Hunter Exam isn't over yet...

episodes.title: A x Dangerous x Watchdog
episodes.overview: Gon, Kurapica, and Leorio arrive at Kukuroo Mountain only to find out that they cannot get close to the Zoldyck family estate. The Zoldyck family owns the mountain and all of the surrounding forest and the entire region is gated shut. There is a guard outpost immediately outside of the gate, but instead of serving as a guard, the man working in there actually cleans up the mess created by the watchdog whenever there are intruders into the grounds. Gon, unwilling to give up on "rescuing" Killua, learns from the gatekeeper that the actual door is the massive stone gate and anyone who enters via that path will not be attacked by the watchdog. Leorio tries to pull and push on the gate, to no avail. The gatekeeper informs them that the gate opens up different amounts of stone slabs based only on the strength of the person; however, the least amount of strength anyone needs to open the smallest portion of the door requires two tons of strength on each side.

episodes.title: The x Guard's x Duty!
episodes.overview: Gon and his friends have decided to pass through the Trial Gate to see Killua. First, they must train in the servants' residence until they can open the gate. Meanwhile, Killua has learned that Gon and the others are here to see him. Gon, Leorio, and Kurapika are able to open the gate after completing their training, but the apprentice butler Canary stands in their way.

episodes.title: The x Zoldyck x Family!
episodes.overview: With help from Canary, who is concerned about Killua, Gon and his friends are getting closer to the mansion. However, Kikyo tells them that Killua cannot see them as he is in solitary confinement. Meanwhile, Killua has been summoned by Silva and asked if he wants to see his friend? Killua answers truthfully, and he is allowed to go see his friends...

episodes.title: Can't See x if x You're x Blind!
episodes.overview: Gon, Kurapika and Leorio arrive at the Butler's Quarters, where the Head Butler entertains them while waiting for Killua. But just what game does he have in mind, and what are the stakes?

episodes.title: Then × And × After
episodes.overview: A letter from Gon arrives at Whale Island for Mito... (A recap of everything that has happened.)

episodes.title: Arrival x At The x Arena!
episodes.overview: Gon and Killua arrive at the Heavens Arena and begin to work their way up, making a new friend, Zushi, who is trained in the martial arts.

episodes.title: Nen x And x "Nen"
episodes.overview: While working to understand Nen and Ren, Gon and Killua run into a familiar acquaintance.

episodes.title: Awakening x And x Potential!
episodes.overview: After reaching the 200th floor, Gon and Killua run into Hisoka's barrier of Nen. They ask Wing to use the violent method for activating their Nen potential. As the deadline for registration draws near, they begin training in one of the four major principles of Nen, Ten.

episodes.title: Fierce x and x Ferocious
episodes.overview: Gon faces the Nen user Gido in his first 200s Heavens Arena match. Gon uses Ten to protect himself, but he soon finds himself on the defense against Gido's Dancing Tops. As Gon desperately tries to find a way to fight back, he makes a bold decision...

episodes.title: Destiny x and x Tenacity!
episodes.overview: A month has passed since Gon was seriously injured, and Hisoka and Kastro are about to fight in Heavens Arena. Kastro was able to knock Hisoka down in the past and sounds very confident in his interview. Hisoka appears unperturbed by the upcoming fight.

episodes.title: A x Surprising x Win
episodes.overview: Kastro has used his ability to create a clone of himself with Nen to sever Hisoka's arm and take an advantage in the fight. However, despite losing both arms, Hisoka appears to be perfectly calm. Kastro loses his cool and attacks Hisoka.

episodes.title: An x Empty x Threat!
episodes.overview: After two months, Gon and Killua are finally allowed to practice Nen again. That's when Gido, Sadaso, and Riehlvelt appear before them and tell them to fight them in the arena. Gon and Killua refuse, but Killua finds Sadaso's behavior to be very suspicious.

episodes.title: Power x To x Avenge!
episodes.overview: Gon has fights against Gido and Riehlvelt coming up. He's still mad about what they did to Zushi. Gon is able to withstand Gido's attacks and overwhelm him in battle. This causes Hisoka to smile.

episodes.title: The x True x Pass
episodes.overview: Gon and Killua begin training in Hatsu, the culmination of everything they've learned about Nen. And finally, Gon challenges Hisoka to return the favor from the Hunter Exam.

episodes.title: A Big Debt x And x A Small Kick!
episodes.overview: After landing a punch on Hisoka, Gon returns the tag from the Hunter Exam. Hisoka is ecstatic to see Gon's development and uses his own Nen to attack. Gon is scared, but he recklessly continues to attack! Will he emerge victorious.

episodes.title: Ging x And x Gon!
episodes.overview: After learning Nen and becoming a true Hunter, Gon returns to Whale Island with Killua. When he arrives, Mito has a box for him. She was told by Ging to give this box to Gon once he became a Hunter. However, it appears that the box cannot be opened.

episodes.title: Reply x From x Dad!
episodes.overview: Gon and Killua have begun to listen to the cassette tape left behind by Ging in anticipation of Gon becoming a Hunter.

episodes.title: Wish x And x Promise!
episodes.overview: Having learned his Nen ability, Kurapika pursues a Hunter's work that will get him close to the New York auction.

episodes.title: Nen x Users x Unite?
episodes.overview: Kurapika and the other job candidates have to battle their way out of the employers mansion... if they ever hope of obtaining any of the items they even need for the job.

episodes.title: Gathering x Of x Heroes!
episodes.overview: The biggest auction in the world is about to take place in York New City. The Phantom Troupe leader, Chrollo, has instructed the members to gather in the city. For what purpose? The band of murdering thieves is about to make its move.

episodes.title: Defend x and x Attack!
episodes.overview: The auction is finally about to begin. Gon, Killua, and Leorio are working hard to amass enough money to buy Greed Island. Kurapika has been assigned to monitor the auction house. Meanwhile, the Phantom Troupe draws close. All paths will soon cross in York New City.

episodes.title: A x Shocking x Tragedy!
episodes.overview: The Phantom Troupe attacks the underground auction held by the Mafia. Afterwards, there is no sign of the merchandise or guests. The Mafia place a reward on their heads and begin pursuit. Kurapika and the other bodyguards on patrol join the pursuit. Kurapika is drawing closer to the Phantom Troupe.

episodes.title: Buildup x To A x Fierce Battle
episodes.overview: After Uvogin slaughters the Mafia's pursuit, the Mafia dispatches their secret weapon, the Shadow Beasts. However, Uvogin is able to defeat them by himself. During the battle, the spider tattoo on Uvogin's back is revealed, and Kurapika springs to action.

episodes.title: Restraint x And x Vow
episodes.overview: Kurapika was able to capture Uvogin, a member of the Phantom Troupe. Kurapika struggles to control his rage as Uvogin makes demands as though he isn't a captive. That is when Kurapika receives an e-mail from Hisoka...

episodes.title: Chasing x and x Waiting
episodes.overview: Uvogin was able to escape with some help from his fellow bandits. However, after the blow to his pride, he is determined to track down and Kurapika and defeat him. Kurapika realizes that the Phantom Troupe has identified their location and moves the boss to a safe place while awaiting the Phantom Troupe's arrival by himself.

episodes.title: Condition x and x Condition
episodes.overview: The anticipated battle between Kurapika and Uvogin begins! Can Kurapika really withstand Uvogin's abilities, and just what are the full extent of the powers in Kurapika's chains?

episodes.title: Very x Sharp x Eye
episodes.overview: Gon, Killua, and Leorio are trying to get their hands on enough money to buy Greed Island. As they pass through the market, Gon stumbles across a way to identify valuable items. The plan is to buy cheap and sell low, but someone else is bidding on all their items.

episodes.title: Pursuit x and x Analysis
episodes.overview: Gon and his friends are hoping to win the reward that's been placed on the Phantom Troupe. At the same time, Machi and Nobunaga have been dispatched to search for the "chain user" because Uvogin hasn't returned. Gon and Killua receive a tip and begin shadowing the two Troupe members.

episodes.title: Ally x and x Sword
episodes.overview: Gon and Killua have been captured by the Phantom Troupe. They are questioned about the chain user that the Troupe is searching for, but the two of them don't know that the chain user is Kurapika. As they're about to be released, Nobunaga decides to keep them around as potential recruits for the Troupe.

episodes.title: A x Brutal x Battlefield
episodes.overview: The auction has been rescheduled, and the Mafia expects the Phantom Troupe to attack again. The Ten Dons have hired multiple assassins to deal with the Phantom Troupe. Light Nostrade sends Kurapika to join the assassins in dispatching of the Troupe.

episodes.title: Assault x And x Impact
episodes.overview: The Troupe is attacking the auction with all their power. The Ten Dons hired assassins are no match, except for Zeno and Silva.

episodes.title: Fake x And x Psyche
episodes.overview: The leader of the Phantom Troupe is dead... Kurapika is shocked by the news. Unconvinced, he tries to get a glimpse of the body. Meanwhile, the dead bodies of the other Troupe members have been discovered.

episodes.title: Fortunes x Aren't x Right?
episodes.overview: Gon, Killua, Kurapika, and Leorio are finally reunited. Kurapika reveals his Nen powers to the others. However, Killua is afraid that Kurapika is now in danger because one of the Troupe members can read minds. Meanwhile, Chrollo is using the fortune telling power he stole from Neon to tell the fortunes of the Troupe members.

episodes.title: Allies x And x Lies
episodes.overview: After Chrollo tells fortunes for all of the Troupe members, they suspect that Hisoka has betrayed them. Hisoka's desire to fight Chrollo drives him to take a big risk by altering his own fortune. Meanwhile, after learning that the Troupe is still alive, Kurapika teams up with Gon and friends and work on a plan to capture Pakunoda.

episodes.title: Beloved x And x Beleaguered
episodes.overview: Chrollo uses the information he has on Neon to identify the location of the chain user, Kurapika. Meanwhile, Killua is keeping an eye on the Phantom Troupe base when he is joined by Melody, who helps determine that the Troupe is headed towards Kurapika's hotel. The Troupe is finally closing in on Kurapika.

episodes.title: Initiative x And x Law
episodes.overview: The Phantom Troupe has learned that Kurapika was the one who killed Uvogin. It's only a matter of time before they realize that the captured Gon and Killua are working with Kurapika? Chrollo takes Gon and killua to the hotel lobby, where Paknoda and the other Troupe members are waiting. Suddenly, the lights go out. Gon and Killua try to escape in the darkness. But Chrollo is the one who has vanished...

episodes.title: Signal x To x Retreat
episodes.overview: Kurapika has captured Chrollo. He offers to release Chrollo if Pakunoda brings Gon and Killua to him. However, Kurapika is unable to control his emotions in the presence of the Troupe leader.

episodes.title: Bid x And x Haste
episodes.overview: The game Greed Island, which holds a clue to finding Ging, is finally on auction. Gon and Killua ask the winning buyer to hire them as players, but they're told that their Nen is too weak. They begin to work on special abilities so they can be selected as players.

episodes.title: End x And x Beginning
episodes.overview: Gon and Killua are trying to get themselves chosen as Greed Island players. Tsezgerra, the judge, says that he will make his decision after they show him his Nen. Only 32 of the 200 applicants will pass.

episodes.title: Invitation x And x Friend
episodes.overview: Gon and Killua have finally made it inside the world of Greed Island, their clue to finding Ging. However, all they found was a message from Ging telling Gon to enjoy the game. Their first step is to find a city and gather information. There, they receive an invitation to join a group that's trying to clear the game.

episodes.title: Reality? x And x Raw
episodes.overview: Gon and Killua set off for Masadora in search of spell cards. On the way, they run into many different monsters. However, they struggle against some of the stronger monsters. A girl named Biscuit watches as they fight their way through.

episodes.title: A x Hard x Master?
episodes.overview: Gon and Killua have finally realized Biscuit's true strength and asked her to teach them Nen. With that said, they begin their hard training.

episodes.title: Strengthen x And x Threaten
episodes.overview: Gon and Killua are gradually improving their Nen under Bisky's tutelage. They are now able to easily capture the monsters that they previously struggled against. While their training draws to an end, the Bomber is paying a visit to the players who have teamed up.

episodes.title: Evil Fist x And x Rock, Paper, Scissors
episodes.overview: After hearing Bisky's lecture on rock-paper-scissors, Gon decides to work on a special technique modeled off of rock-paper-scissors by using Enhancer, Emitter, and Conjurer abilities. Meanwhile, Killua leaves the game temporarily to take the HUnter Exam. While he's gone, Gon and Bisky find learn about the Bomber's most recent attack.

episodes.title: Strategy x And x Scheme
episodes.overview: Killua returns after easily passing his second try at the Hunter Exam. Now that Gon, Killua, and Bisky are together again, they begin working on beating this game by collecting cards. Meanwhile, the other players are scheming to gather the cards they need to complete the game.

episodes.title: 15 x 15
episodes.overview: Team Genthru now has 96 different types of restricted slot cards after tricking Team Tsegzerra. Gon and Killua receive an invitation from other players to team up to prevent Genthru from beating the game. They head to Soufrabi to monopolize Patch of Shore, one of the cards Genthru is missing.

episodes.title: Pirates x And x Guesses
episodes.overview: The condition for obtaining Patch of Shore is to chase a band of fifteen pirates out of town. Gon and crew are immediately taken to the boss, Razor, but they are quickly defeated. The plan is to recruit stronger party members and try again, so they start with the player named Chrollo.

episodes.title: A x Heated x Showdown
episodes.overview: Gon and his friends have teamed up with Hisoka and Goreinu to challenge Razor again. To round out the party, they recruit Team Tsezgerra. Their preparations allow them to breeze through the first few matches, but then Razor challenges them to a game of dodgeball.

episodes.title: Guts x And x Courage
episodes.overview: Gon is unable to hold onto Razor's throw and is sent to the outfield. He uses Back to return, but Hisoka is also injured and the situation looks grim. However, Gon has an idea for defeating Razor, but he needs Killua's help to pull it off.

episodes.title: Bargain x And x Deal
episodes.overview: Gon, Killua, and Hisoka team up to catch Razor's strongest throw. They're taking Razor head on. Once the ball has been secured, Gon uses all of his strength to launch it at Razor. The game of dodgeball is drawing to a close.

episodes.title: Chase x And x Chance
episodes.overview: In order to beat the game, the other players must face off against Genthru. Tsezgerra offers to distract Genthru for three weeks. While Gon trains hard, Team Tsezgerra leaves the game temporarily to delay Genthru, but Mr. Battera has an unpleasant surprise for them.

episodes.title: Insanity x And x Sanity
episodes.overview: Tsezgerra's tea has not returned to the game. Genthru finally turns his attention to Gon's group. Gon faces off against Genthru, Killua is against Sub, and Bisky takes Bara.

episodes.title: Victor x And x Loser
episodes.overview: Genthru has shown that he is much stronger than Gon. However, after Gon refuses to back down, he finally uses Little Flower to severely injure Gon.

episodes.title: Ging's Friends x And x True Friends
episodes.overview: After defeating Genthru and collecting 99 restricted cards, Gon and his friends participate in the final event, a quiz tournament open to all players. After winning, Gon receives Ruler's Invitation.

episodes.title: Reunion x And x Understanding
episodes.overview: Gon and Killua use the cards they brought back from the game to warp to Nigg, who they believe is Ging. However, they are sent to a completely different man who immediately knocks them to the ground. However, Gon finds him familiar for some reason.

episodes.title: Unease x And x Sighting
episodes.overview: Gon and Killua join Kite's team as they investigate the Chimera Ants. The Chimera Ants are dangerous insects that can pass traits from the prey they consume to their offspring. As Kite begins to fear the worst, the Chimera Ants begin to feed on humans.

episodes.title: Very x Rapid x Reproduction
episodes.overview: Kite uses the location where the Chimera Ant arm was discovered and ocean patterns to determine where the actual Chimera Ant is. It turns out to be an isolated country that bans all forms of technology. Meanwhile, the Chimera Ants continue to evolve.

episodes.title: No x Good x NGL
episodes.overview: After passing a strict border checkpoint, Gon and his new friends enter NGL where they suspect the Chimera Ant is. However, ten other teams of Hunters have already arrived before them. Meanwhile, the Chimera Ants, with their new names and individual personalities, are attacking humans.

episodes.title: Evil x And x Terrible
episodes.overview: Pokkle and Ponzu use Ponzu's bees to deliver messages asking the Hunter Association to help eliminate the Chimera Ants. Meanwhile, the Chimera Ants have attacked Gyro, the shadowy ruler of NGL, and taken his guns. As the situation gets worse, Ponzu's message reaches Gon's group.

episodes.title: The x Fight x Begins
episodes.overview: Gon, Killua, and Kite discover the remains of a destroyed village. There, they encounter their first Chimera Ant. Gon and Killua are shaken by the speed and power displayed by the Chimera Ant. However, Kite tells them that they must defeat the Chimera Ant or leave.

episodes.title: Kite x And x Slots
episodes.overview: Some of the more aggressive Chimera Ants have eaten the villains who ran the NGL underground and grown increasingly evil. When Gon looks away from their gruesome act, Kite admonishes him. Now, they must battle for their lives. Meanwhile, a Chimera Ant is on the verge of discovering Nen.

episodes.title: Inspiration x To x Evolve
episodes.overview: The Hunter Association has dispatched an expeditionary force to exterminate the Chimera Ants. Meanwhile, Gon and his friends are being targeted by Chimera Ants who seek to eat rare humans. They are forced into one-on-one battles with Chimera Ant captains. They easily dispatch their opponents, but Kite continues to feel uneasy. less.

episodes.title: A x Fated x Awakening
episodes.overview: As Gon, Killua and Kite approach the nest, one of the Chimera Ant Royal Guards, Neferpitou, awakens. Upon extracting information from a surviving Hunter, Neferpitou learns the secrets of Nen, including the means to awaken and control it.

episodes.title: Light x And x Darkness
episodes.overview: As the Chimera Ants are reunited to unlock the power of Nen into their bodies, Neferpitou feels the presence of Kite approaching and leaves to confront him. Realizing that the enemy is too powerful for them, Kite warns Gon and Killua to flee, but Gon is taken by rage upon seeing Kite's arm being severed by Neferpitou and Killua is forced to knock him down and escape carrying him. After escaping the NGL, with Gon still uncounscious, Killua is approached by Chairman Netero who is sent there to wipe out the Chimera Ants assisted by two other Pro Hunters, Morel and Knov.

episodes.title: Promise x And x Reunion
episodes.overview: Gon and Killua meet Knov's student Palm and learn that to earn a place in the Extermination Squad and return to the NGL, they must win against Morel's students Knuckle and Shoot in one month. To increase their chances of winning, Palm asks for Biscuit's help and they start a harsh training routine with her. Meanwhile at the Chimera Ants nest, Shaiapouf, the second Royal Guard awakens.

episodes.title: Duel x And x Escape
episodes.overview: After completing their training, Biscuit sends the exausted Gon and Killua to face Knuckle. Looking at the condition fo their opponents, Knuckle boasts that they could never move him an inch and bets his token on it. However His assumptions are proven wrong when Gon manages to land a powerful hit that knocks him out cold, and after awakening, Knuckle agrees that he will help them with their training until the deadline for returning the token comes. Meanwhile at the nest, Neferpitou focuses herself into reviving Kite for a second chance to fight him and Netero's team starts taking down small groups of Chimera Ants that bring the attention of the captains, while the king grows strong inside the queen's womb. As Gon and Killua spend their days training with Biscuit and sparring with Knuckle, Shoot, the second of Morel's disciples make plans about how to deal with them.

episodes.title: Rock-Paper-Scissors x And x Weakness
episodes.overview: As the deadline established by Netero approaches, the chairman and his companions continue to wipe out the Chimera Ant squads one by one. While the remaining squad captains discuss how to deal with the problem, the final member of the royal guard, Menthuthuyoupi, is born. Meanwhile, Gon and Killua complete their training and challenge Knuckle for real.

episodes.title: Compassion x And x Strength
episodes.overview: As the battle with Knuckle begins, Gon is told that his Janken technique is fatally flawed - but Gon exploits this weakness, countering as his opponent tries to take advantage. Just as Gon is about to deal a finishing blow, he collapses from exhaustion. With the deadline the next day, the final showdown is looming. As Gon sleeps, Biscuit spars with Killua, after which she explains the nature of his own weakness. She issues an ultimatum - should he lose the next day's battle, he must leave Gon's side.

episodes.title: Slow x And x Cursed
episodes.overview: Gon and Killua are finally facing off against Knuckle and Shoot. Killua takes Shoot while Gon's opponent is Knuckle. Gon succeeds in sensing Knuckle through his aura, but then LoanBoy pops up on his left arm. Meanwhile, Killua is struggling against Shoot.

episodes.title: The Strong x And x The Weak
episodes.overview: At long last, the Queen gives birth to the King. The Chimera Ants are cowed by the menancing aura emitted by the King. Pitou, Pouf, and Youpi kneel before the King to greet him, but with that gesture, they have abandoned the Queen.

episodes.title: One Wish x And x Two Promises
episodes.overview: Despite all efforts to save the queen, she does not resist her wounds and dies, but not before revealing to Colt the name she had chosen for the king, "Meruem". A final live offspring is found inside her body and Morel offers himself to protect both after he promises that they will never eat humans anymore. As the other squad leaders leave to build their own colonies, the king and the royal guard arrive at the neighboring country of East Gorteau.

episodes.title: Date x With x Palm
episodes.overview: As the king kills the ruler of East Gorteau and takes over the country, Gon and Killua return to meet Palm, prepared to face her fury upon failing to fulfill their promise, but she decides to forgive them when Gon accepts her request to have a date with her. After learning from Morel that they found Kite, Gon takes Palm for her date, while Killua keeps trailing them in case of an enemy attack, and his fears are confirmed when Rammot appears before him.

episodes.title: Friend x And x Journey
