episodes.overview: High school jock, Sharpner, discovers his crush, Videl, has her heart set on the mysterious Great Saiyaman! Refusing to be replaced, Sharpner vows to ruin the caped fighter by unmasking his true identity and capturing it on film!

episodes.title: The World Tournament
episodes.overview: The action begins as the World Martial Arts Tournament opens with the Junior Division! Thirty-five young fighters vie for the prize, but the matches prove to be more comedy than competition - until Trunks steps into the ring!

episodes.title: Trunks vs. Goten
episodes.overview: Goten and Trunks breeze through the Junior Division of the tournament until they find themselves going head-to-head in the finals! Who will win this exciting match? This is one championship fight you won't want to miss!

episodes.title: Best of the Boys
episodes.overview: The match for the Junior Division World Championship continues as Goten and Trunks battle for the title! The winner of this final joust becomes the new World Champion! Can Goten outwit the cunning Trunks?

episodes.title: Big Trouble, Little Trunks
episodes.overview: After winning the championship, Trunks fights an exhibition match against Mr. Satan! Can the Champ hold on to his reputation as the world's strongest fighter? Meanwhile, two mysterious figures reveal themselves to Goku!

episodes.title: Who Will Fight Who?
episodes.overview: Trunks and Gohan infiltrate the adult competition at the tournament by donning the disguise of Mighty Mask. The pairings for the day’s matches are selected. The first to fight: Krillin vs. Pintar, a man easily ten times Krillin’s size!

episodes.title: Forfeit of Piccolo
episodes.overview: Piccolo stuns the crowd by surrendering to his mysterious opponent before the first punch is thrown! Next into the ring is Videl, who must face the enormous Spopovitch. Will she be able to handle such a large job?

episodes.title: A Dark and Secret Power
episodes.overview: Videl takes to the ring for what is expected to be an easy victory over Spopovitch. She hits the towering brute with everything she’s got, but her attacks have no effect. It seems Spopovitch is possessed by a supernatural power!

episodes.title: Videl Is Crushed
episodes.overview: To everyone’s horror, Spopovitch delays his inevitable victory for the purposes of torturing Videl! It appears the muscle-bound thug isn’t going to stop until he kills her! Will Videl make it out of the ring alive?

episodes.title: Identities Revealed
episodes.overview: Gohan’s identity is finally discovered as he takes his place on the tournament floor, but he has bigger things to worry about. His opponent, Kibito, is determined to see him transform into a Super Saiyan!

episodes.title: Energy Drain
episodes.overview: When Gohan transforms into a Super Saiyan, Spopovitch and Yamu spring into action! Armed with a mysterious energy-draining device, the pair launch an attack on the golden-haired teen.

episodes.title: The Wizard's Curse
episodes.overview: The Z-Fighters race to stop Babidi’s cronies from delivering the pure energy that will be used resurrect the dreaded Majin Buu. Will they find Babidi’s hidden spaceship in time?

episodes.title: King of the Demons
episodes.overview: Piccolo and Krillin are turned to stone by Dabura! Determined to save their friends, Goku, Gohan, and Vegeta board Babidi’s ship only to find themselves trapped! Can they save their friends and find their way out?

episodes.title: Vegeta Attacks
episodes.overview: At each stage of Babidi’s ship, Goku, Gohan, and Vegeta must face a fearsome warrior, each more powerful than the last. There’s no room for error! Even the tiniest mistake will enable Babidi to steal their energy for Majin Buu!

episodes.title: Next Up, Goku
episodes.overview: Babidi unleashes his monster Yakon to steal the Z-Fighters’ energy for Majin Buu. The battle at Stage Two is sure to be intense, as Yakon is one of the most fearsome creatures in the universe!

episodes.title: Battle Supreme
episodes.overview: At the World Martial Arts Tournament, the five remaining competitors enter the ring for an all-out Battle Royale! The fists fly as Number 18, Mighty Mask, and Mr. Satan duke it out to decide who will be the next Champion of the World!

episodes.title: Eighteen Unmasks
episodes.overview: The battle heats up as Number 18 and Mighty Mask take their fight to the skies! Number 18 gives it everything she’s got, but her attacks prove useless against her masked opponent. Could she find the edge she needs to win?

episodes.title: Pay to Win
episodes.overview: As the final bout of the tournament continues, Number 18 throws the defending champ for a loop by offering to throw the fight! Meanwhile, Babidi has selected his warrior for Stage 3: Dabura, King of the Demon World!

episodes.title: Heart of a Villain
episodes.overview: The intense battle between Gohan and Dabura rages on, but just as the Stage 3 clash reaches a heated peak, Dabura stops the fight! Why has the evil giant conceded, and what is the great discovery he claims to have made?

episodes.title: The Dark Prince Returns
episodes.overview: In an all-out assault against Vegeta, Babidi uses his power to undo the unsuspecting Prince from within! Vegeta is stripped of his good qualities by the wicked wizard, and becomes the heartless warrior that he once was!

episodes.title: Vegeta's Pride
episodes.overview: Evil Vegeta gives Goku an ultimatum: fight - or watch him annihilate more innocent lives! Goku vows to settle the score between them once and for all, but the Supreme Kai steps between the Saiyans with a bold declaration!

episodes.title: The Long Awaited Fight
episodes.overview: The battle between Goku and Vegeta has begun! With Babidi’s magic enhancing his already incredible strength, Vegeta matches Goku move for move, but every blow the Saiyan Prince lands is a boost for Majin Buu!

episodes.title: Magic Ball of Buu
episodes.overview: With the fight between Goku and Vegeta supplying vast quantities of energy for Majin Buu, there’s not a moment to lose! Can Gohan muster up the strength to stop the evil wizard before it’s too late?

episodes.title: Buu Is Hatched
episodes.overview: The seal encasing Buu is finally broken! Supreme Kai insists on retreat, but Gohan refuses, launching an incredible series of energy attacks. When the shell opens, nothing is inside! Gohan, however, knows it’s no time to celebrate.

episodes.title: The Losses Begin
episodes.overview: With his big pink belly and infantile behavior, Buu doesn’t fit the bill of a galaxy destroyer - until he hurls Dabura into a cliff with a single blow! Gohan senses a limitless power, and the Supreme Kai insists this is the end!

episodes.title: The Terror of Mr. Buu
episodes.overview: Supreme Kai must use his unique fighting powers to keep Buu at bay - or lose his life! One mile away, Goten and Trunks stumble upon Piccolo, still frozen in stone, and accidentally shatter him to pieces! And there’s more! The King of Demons returns!

episodes.title: Meal Time
episodes.overview: Free from the grip of Babidi, Vegeta decides to seek his revenge by destroying the monster Majin Buu. Assuming Gohan to be a victim of the voracious villain, the Super Saiyan goes ballistic. Can Vegeta bring down Buu?

episodes.title: The Warrior's Decision
episodes.overview: With Goku and Gohan missing in action, it’s up to Vegeta to end Majin Buu’s reign of terror. The Saiyan prince gives it his all, but Buu’s powers may be more than he can handle!

episodes.title: Final Atonement
episodes.overview: Trunks and Goten save Vegeta from a savage beating, but the prideful prince is determined to destroy Majin Buu by himself. Vegeta is prepared to risk everything to defeat this foe, but is he really ready to give up his own life?

episodes.title: Evil Lives On
episodes.overview: Majin Buu’s flesh is scattered on the battlefield, but his mystical power is rebuilding the monster into one deadly piece! Babidi is recovering, too, having narrowly survived Piccolo’s attack!

episodes.title: Find the Dragon Balls
episodes.overview: Anxious to undo the massacre caused by Vegeta, Bulma and the others search frantically for the seven Dragon Balls! Meanwhile, the injured Goku finally awakens, and Dende uses his healing powers to bring him back to speed!

episodes.title: Revival
episodes.overview: Goku hatches a plan for defeating Majin Buu: Fusion! By joining two fighters of equal size and strength, an entirely new fighter can be created. But only one such pair remains—Goten and Trunks! Can the young half-Saiyans save the world?

episodes.title: Global Announcement
episodes.overview: Babidi seeks vengeance against Piccolo, Goten, and Trunks! Plastering images on everyone’s mind, Babidi threatens to terrorize humanity until the trio is brought forward! Meanwhile, Gohan is taken to Supreme Kai’s world!

episodes.title: Learn to Fuse!
episodes.overview: Goku begins training Goten and Trunks in the art of Fusion. Meanwhile, Gohan, having been healed in Supreme Kai’s world, tries to remove the legendary Z-Sword to use in the fight against Majin Buu!

episodes.title: The Z Sword
episodes.overview: Majin Buu launches into a feeding frenzy, transforming an entire town’s population into chocolate! Gohan draws the ancient Z-Sword, Goku struggles to teach Goten and Trunks the art of Fusion, and an unlikely hero is asked to join the fight!

episodes.title: Race to Capsule Corp.
episodes.overview: As Goten and Trunks train to stop the vicious Majin Buu, Idasa’s jaded mother tells Babidi exactly where Trunks lives! The Z-Fighters must now find a way to stop the evil wizard before he reaches Capsule Corp!

episodes.title: Super Saiyan 3?!
episodes.overview: Trunks searches frantically for the lost dragon radar, and Goku powers-up to an unimaginable level: Super Saiyan 3! Will this newfound strength be enough to stop Majin Buu from destroying West City?

episodes.title: Buu's Mutiny
episodes.overview: Goku uses his new Super Saiyan 3 abilities to combat the evil Majin Buu, buying Trunks the time he needs to locate the missing Dragon Radar. But now that Goku has started the fight, he may not be able to escape!

episodes.title: The Fusion Dance
episodes.overview: Liberated from his master, Majin Buu becomes even more destructive than before, wiping out entire cities in mere seconds! Earth’s only hope now rests on the shoulders of two young warriors: Goten and Trunks!

episodes.title: Goku's Time Is Up
episodes.overview: Tensions rise for Goten and Trunks as their duel with Majin Buu approaches. Meanwhile, Buu prepares for the upcoming battle by building himself a home! Elsewhere, Goku bids a poignant farewell as he finally returns to Other World.

episodes.title: Return to Other World
episodes.overview: While Trunks and Goten continue their quest to perfect the Fusion Technique, Gohan seeks to master the Z-Sword. Back on Earth, an encounter with a blind boy reveals that there is another side to the belligerent Buu!

episodes.title: Out from the Broken Sword
episodes.overview: When Gohan’s intense training breaks the legendary Z-Sword, all hope seems lost until Old Kai emerges and from the legendary weapon. Who is this aged fellow, and does he really have the incredible power he claims to possess?

episodes.title: Gotenks Is Born
episodes.overview: After many comical misfires, Trunks and Goten finally perfect the Fusion technique, and Gotenks is born! Defying Piccolo’s command, the super-kid immediately leaves to go fight Majin Buu! Is Gotenks ready for the fight of his young life?

episodes.title: Unlikely Friendship
episodes.overview: As Majin Buu continues to terrorize humanity, a lone savior appears: Mr. Satan! His Megaton punch won’t be enough to stop the monster, but this unlikely hero may have a few surprises in store for Buu!

episodes.title: I Kill No More
episodes.overview: While the Z-Fighters continue training in preparation for their battle with Majin Buu, Mr. Satan devises some sneakier plans to take the villain down. But will he even need to carry them out? Is Majin Buu having a change of heart?

episodes.title: The Evil of Men
episodes.overview: When Mr. Satan inspires Majin Buu to give up his evil ways, it seems the professional pretender has really saved the world! But when a deranged madman suddenly spoils Buu’s good mood, the pink terror goes on another rampage!

episodes.title: Buu Against Buu
episodes.overview: The Battle of the Buus begins as Majin Buu fights his evil counterpart! The good Buu gets a taste of his own medicine when he’s turned into chocolate! Evil Buu gobbles him up, and a horrible transformation takes place! Who is this radical new Buu?

episodes.title: Empty Planet
episodes.overview: When the new and improved Majin Buu makes a surprise visit to the Lookout to challenge Gotenks, every second becomes a test of survival! And where are Trunks and Goten during the chaos that erupts?... Sound asleep, of course!

episodes.title: Time Struggle
episodes.overview: Before he can unleash his fury on the remaining Z-Fighters, Majin Buu is coaxed into the Hyperbolic Time Chamber. Inside, Trunks and Goten are training diligently, but will they have enough time to perfect their new moves before Majin Buu arrives?

episodes.title: Super Moves of Gotenks
episodes.overview: The long awaited rematch between Majin Buu and Gotenks begins! But when Gotenks’ fighting techniques come up short, he is forced to improvise - resulting in some of the craziest attack moves ever!

episodes.title: Trapped in Forever
episodes.overview: The battle between Gotenks and Majin Buu rages on inside the Hyperbolic Time Chamber. On the outside, family and friends wait anxiously for Gotenks and Piccolo to reappear. Can they successfully defeat Majin Buu and make it out alive?

episodes.title: Feeding Frenzy
episodes.overview: Powered by his insatiable hunger, Majin Buu escapes the Hyperbolic Time Chamber, leaving Piccolo and Gotenks trapped inside. Krillin and the gang are forced to fight the monster on their own. Will Buu finally make a meal out of the good guys?

episodes.title: Gotenks Is Awesome!
episodes.overview: Super Saiyan 3 Gotenks continues his fight with Majin Buu, and the Lookout is caught in the crossfire! As Gotenks turns up the power, so does Majin Buu - and by the time it’s over, one of them will be in way over his head!

episodes.title: Unlucky Break
episodes.overview: Gohan continues his training on the World of the Kais. Meanwhile, Gotenks briefly takes the upper hand in the battle with Majin Buu before his techniques begin to fall apart. Will Gohan be ready in time to step in and finish the fight?

episodes.title: A Whole New Gohan
episodes.overview: When Gotenks’ fusion unravels, it appears the end has finally come for Goten and Trunks. But just as things seem their worst, Gohan descends on the scene with his newly awakened powers! Finally, the tables are turning on Majin Buu!

episodes.title: Search for Survivors
episodes.overview: After being dominated on the battlefield, Majin Buu blows himself up in a desperate attempt to destroy Gohan! But is this just a ploy? Gohan seems to think so! Is Majin Buu plotting an ambush or simply trying to buy a little time?

episodes.title: Majin-Buu Transforms
episodes.overview: Majin Buu reappears, ready for battle, but rather than continue his fight against Gohan, Buu stages a clever deception to absorb Gotenks and Piccolo. With the wisdom of Piccolo and the power of Super Saiyan Gotenks, Buu transforms into “Super Buu!”

episodes.title: The Old Kai's Weapon
episodes.overview: After absorbing Piccolo and Gotenks, Majin Buu’s powers have increased exponentially! Armed with some new tricks, Majin Buu is poised for global destruction. Now that Gohan is alone and weakening, is there anyone who can stop the monster?

episodes.title: Ready to Fuse?
episodes.overview: Goku watches helplessly from Other World as Majin Buu sets his sights on Gohan. Luckily the Old Kai reveals a secret source of power that could save the day. Is Goku ready to bond with his son and put an end to Majin Buu’s reign of terror?

episodes.title: Union of Rivals
episodes.overview: After Majin Buu absorbs Gohan, Goku’s plan to join forces with his son is ruined. But an unlikely ally arrives on the scene—Vegeta! Will the Saiyan Prince put aside his differences and agree to merge with Goku?

episodes.title: Meet Vegito
episodes.overview: The bodies of Goku and Vegeta join to form a new Saiyan warrior. The monster Majin Buu is impressed by the strength of his new opponent, but refuses to take him seriously. Will Majin Buu’s arrogance be his undoing?

episodes.title: Rip in the Universe
episodes.overview: The newly-formed Saiyan warrior Super Vegito matches Majin Buu punch for punch. But the monster’s new opponent stirs up an uncontrollable anger within the very heart of the beast. Will Majin Buu’s frenzy mean the end of planet Earth?

episodes.title: Vegito... Downsized
episodes.overview: The battle rages on between Vegito and Majin Buu! The Super Saiyan Combo seems to have the fight well in hand. But is Vegito tempting fate by toying with Buu? What terrible tricks does the wily, pink monster still have up his sleeve?

episodes.title: The Incredible Fighting Candy
episodes.overview: Having been reduced to a coffee-flavored candy, it seems nothing can stop Vegito from being consumed by the evil Majin Buu. But when the gumdrop fights back, Buu realizes that the battle is far from over!

episodes.title: The Innards of Buu
episodes.overview: When Majin Buu absorbs Vegito, the fused Saiyan separates into Goku and Vegeta once again. Deep within the villain, they reveal their plan to rescue Gohan and the others. Can the duo survive the digestive process and carry out their mission?

episodes.title: Mind Trap
episodes.overview: Dangers abound as Goku and Vegeta continue their search for Gohan and inside of Majin Buu’s body! After meeting some disgusting bedfellows, they finally find what they’re looking for as they enter Majin Buu’s head!

episodes.title: Deadly Vision
episodes.overview: Goku and Vegeta reunite the others only to be attacked by Majin Buu! The showdown proves that fighting Buu inside his own head is a mind-bending experience. Can Goku and Vegeta survive in this twisted house of horrors where all is Buu?

episodes.title: Evil Kid Buu!
episodes.overview: When Super Buu’s body begins to mutate once again, Goku and Vegeta have to get out fast! But what awaits them should they manage to escape? What will the insidious Buu turn into next?

episodes.title: End of Earth
episodes.overview: After the cords of attachment to the roly-poly Buu are cut by Vegeta, Majin Buu should mutate into a much weaker form. But instead he gets even stronger! This baffles everyone but Kibito Kai, who discloses Majin Buu's bizarre history!

episodes.title: True Saiyans Fight Alone
episodes.overview: With Earth erased from existence, Majin Buu begins his search for Goku and Vegeta, leaving entire worlds destroyed in his wake. But when Buu's hunt leads him to the World of the Kais, Goku and Vegeta draw the line!

episodes.title: Battle for the Universe Begins
episodes.overview: With Majin Buu ready for a fight, Kibito Kai is stunned to see Goku and Vegeta playing a game of Rock, Paper, Scissors! Rather than use the Fusion Technique to join their powers, the duo has decided to fight Buu one at a time!

episodes.title: Vegeta's Respect
episodes.overview: When Super Saiyan 3 Goku collapses from exhaustion, Vegeta enters the fight, but he doesn’t last long! Just as Majin Buu is about to deliver the deathblow, Goku makes a comeback!

episodes.title: Minute of Desperation
episodes.overview: Goku's powers are fading, and he must end the battle before it's too late! Enter Vegeta, who begins a furious battle with Buu to buy Goku the time needed to gather energy. Outclassed by his opponent, can the Saiyan Prince survive!?

episodes.title: Old Buu Emerges
episodes.overview: When Vegeta falls, Mr. Satan steps in to take up the challenge! It appears the wannabe hero has signed his death warrant, but when Buu attempts to attack, the monster is crippled by agony!

episodes.title: Earth Reborn
episodes.overview: As good Majin Buu wages an all-out war against his evil counterpart, Vegeta asks Dende to summon the Dragon on the new Planet Namek. With the good Buu's power dwindling, will Vegeta have enough time to carry out the final phase of his plan?

episodes.title: Call to Action
episodes.overview: Goku awaits the arrival of the Earthlings’ collective energy to vitalize the Spirit Bomb, but the energy isn’t coming! Have the people of the Earth turned a deaf ear to Vegeta’s plea for help at this most critical hour?

episodes.title: People of Earth Unite
episodes.overview: The foolish Earthlings ignore Goku, but when Mr. Satan asks for help, the humans have a change of heart. Will their outpouring of energy arrive in time? Goku can only wait and watch as Vegeta crumbles under the might of Majin Buu!

episodes.title: Spirit Bomb Triumphant
episodes.overview: After the good Buu and Mr. Satan free Vegeta, Goku launches the Spirit Bomb! Unfortunately, the weary Saiyan doesn’t have enough power to deliver the blast, and Buu sends it right back at him! Will Goku be destroyed by his own attack?

episodes.title: Celebrations with Majin Buu
episodes.overview: When Goku and his companions return to Earth after defeating Majin Buu, they are welcomed with open arms. But nobody is happy to see the good Buu! Can Mr. Satan’s pink pal manage to fit into society? Or is he destined to become an outcast?

episodes.title: He's Always Late
episodes.overview: Goku has his hands full guarding four dragon eggs from the dangers of the wild, but even if he can save the baby dragons, he will soon face an even more dangerous peril: an angry Chi Chi!

episodes.title: Granddaughter Pan
episodes.overview: It’s been ten years since the demise of evil Majin Buu, and Earth is once again at peace. Gohan is a scholar. Trunks and Goten are strong, young teenagers! Vegeta and Bulma have a new daughter! And Goku is a grandfather!

episodes.title: Buu's Reincarnation
episodes.overview: A new World Tournament is set to begin! With help from Majin Buu, Goku rigs the drawing so he faces a mysterious fighter in the first round of the finals! Is this timid, little village boy called Uub really as strong as Goku thinks?

episodes.title: Goku's Next Journey
episodes.overview: Uub grows stronger as the battle rages, soon becoming the Saiyan’s equal, but before the match is decided, Goku makes a startling revelation! With his plan revealed, Goku and Uub depart the arena, leaving a stunned crowd in their wake.

episodes.title: The Sphere
episodes.overview: Bullied outcast Rudo finds respite in repurposing trash, until a terrible tragedy changes his life forever.

episodes.title: The Inhabited
episodes.overview: Cast into the Pit, Rudo is saved by the mysterious Enjin who may not have his best interests at heart.

episodes.title: The Ground
episodes.overview: Enjin is a Giver, a being who can give life to things and draw out their power. Ludo, who has also awakened to his power as a Giver, is scouted by Enjin to join an organization called the Cleaners, which fights against the Spotted Beasts born from garbage. Ludo accepts the offer in order to find a way to return to the Heavenly World where he has lived until now, but he suddenly gets into a fight with his trainer, Zanca.

episodes.title: Cleaner HQ
episodes.overview: After being introduced to Cleaner HQ, Rudo follows Riyo on a job to learn the business.

episodes.title: Raiders
episodes.overview: The Cleaners go on a job to save another Sphereite who survived the fall. Rudo tags along to learn more.

episodes.title: One Good Strike!!
episodes.overview: With the job having gone terribly wrong, Rudo finds himself face to face with a merciless Raider named Jabber.

episodes.title: A Score to Settle
episodes.overview: Jabber employs a new strategy to get through Rudo's defenses, and another ally joins the fray.

episodes.title: Moving Forward
episodes.overview: Rudo deals with the emotional aftermath of the Jabber fight and gets a new lead about returning to the Sphere.

episodes.title: The City of Graffiti
episodes.overview: To get a "spell" for their next mission, the Cleaners head to Canvas Town, where they make a tragic discovery.

episodes.title: Penta: The Desert No Man's Land
episodes.overview: With their gear-up complete, the crew heads into the No Man's Land, Penta, to get clues about the Sphere.

episodes.title: Amo's Hospitality
episodes.overview: A mysterious woman living in the No Man's Land challenges the crew from an unexpected angle.

episodes.title: Something Like a Curse
episodes.overview: Tamsy and Zanka fight to save their captive allies. In the aftermath, Rudo has an unexpected reaction.

episodes.title: An Empty Gaze
episodes.overview: Amo tells the story of how she came to the tower and of the "angels" who came to visit her.

episodes.title: The Storm Before the Storm
episodes.overview: After returning from the Penta No Man's Land, Rudo and the Cleaners face a series of new threats.

episodes.title: Clash!
episodes.overview: Taken by the Raiders to an unknown setting, the Cleaners fight for their lives, and Zodyl makes Rudo an offer.

episodes.title: Gifted and Not
episodes.overview: Bundus interrogates the Santas while Zanka struggles to keep pace with a powered-up Jabber.

episodes.title: Memories of a Mediocrity
episodes.overview: Zanka reflects on the turning point in his past that brought him to where he is today.

episodes.title: Oh Zap, Totes Legit
episodes.overview: While the Raiders-Cleaners conflicts continue, the battle between Riyo and Noerde heats up.

episodes.title: Watchmen Series
episodes.overview: Zodyl reveals his plan to reach the Sphere, and the other Cleaners react to their current circumstances.

episodes.title: Ensign
episodes.overview: As the battle climaxes, Enjin makes a play to unite his team, and Zodyl makes his final entreaty to Rudo.

episodes.title: Race Against Time
episodes.overview: Exiled from his home, Rudo seeks vengeance on those responsible. But first, he must survive a wasteland.

episodes.title: The Power of Protection
episodes.overview: Noerde is doing everything he can to prevent the cleaning crew from escaping before they cross the border on the haphazard contraption.

episodes.title: The Man Who Will Be Stronger
episodes.overview: As the Cleaners take stock after the battle, a convalescing Zanka receives some surprising news.

episodes.title: Field Trip
episodes.overview: Rudo and the other child Cleaners take a trip to Canvas Town while Corvus entertains some unwanted guests.

episodes.title: The Death Row Convict and the Executioner
episodes.overview: Gabimaru, a ninja member of a clan of assassins, is sentenced to death. He claims to have nothing to tie him to life, yet no method of execution manages to end his life. His meeting with Sagiri Yamada Asaemon, who seems to be investigating him, will change everything.

episodes.title: Screening and Choosing
episodes.overview: The condemned criminals are gathered on the beach to prepare for the expedition to Shinsenkyo, but first, they must reduce their numbers.

episodes.title: Weakness and Strength
episodes.overview: Gabimaru, Sagiri, and the others arrive on Shinsenkyo, and their battle for survival begins.

episodes.title: Hell and Paradise
episodes.overview: Gabimaru and Sagiri are in trouble during their first fight against the island's mysterious creatures. Gabimaru is unaware of these monstrosities and this puts him at a disadvantage in battle. The sudden arrival of Yuzuriha, the female ninja, will change the situation, but Gabimaru does not see clearly in her game.

episodes.title: The Samurai and the Woman
episodes.overview: Gabimaru and Sagiri's group cross paths with another Yamada Asaemon, Genji, who takes a dim view of Sagiri's involvement in the present matter. Meanwhile, Yamada Asaemon Tenza tries to find a way off the island along with his charge, Nurugai.

episodes.title: Heart and Reason
episodes.overview: Rokurota starts to cause serious problems for Sagiri and Gabimaru, and now they must think of a strategy to defeat him!

episodes.title: Flowers and Offerings
episodes.overview: Chobe and Toma encounter people unlike any they've ever encountered before. Gabimaru and Sagiri's party finally meet people who live on the island.

episodes.title: Student and Master
episodes.overview: Tenza and Nurugai also encounter one of the island's strange denizens with unfathomable power. All seems lost before they encounter another Yamada Asaemon...

episodes.title: Gods and People
episodes.overview: Sagiri's group sets off in search of Horai. Gabimaru goes ahead and encounters the same powerful being that confronted Tenza...

episodes.title: Yin and Yang
episodes.overview: Mei attempts to explain something very important to Sagiri's party in the forest. Shion tries to explain how he interacts with the world to Nurugai. A mysterious servant of the Tensen tries to explain why Aza Chobe and Toma shouldn't escape.

episodes.title: Weak and Strong
episodes.overview: Chobe brings new abilities to bear as he faces the Tensen's servants. A secret of Mei's is revealed to Gabimaru, hardening his resolve to fight and opening him up to a new perception of the world.

episodes.title: Umbrella and Ink
episodes.overview: Mu Dan confronts Sagiri's party and reveals shocking truths about the island's true nature.

episodes.title: Dreams and Reality
episodes.overview: Sagiri's party faces Mu Dan's seemingly unstoppable true form. Shion does his best to rise to the challenge with his mastery of waves.

episodes.title: Dawn and Confusion
episodes.overview: Shugen and Jikka are sent to Shinsenkyo, while Gabimaru and his companions battle Aza Chobe and Toma.

episodes.title: Reality and Fantasy
episodes.overview: Aza Chobe and Gabimaru lose themselves in battle, but Mei stops their fight.

episodes.title: Immutability and Change
episodes.overview: While Aza Chobe battles Rien, Gabimaru regains his memories and begins training in the use of tao.

episodes.title: The Samurai Code and Carnage
episodes.overview: Sagiri believes Shugen will be an ally and eagerly anticipates the expedition's arrival, but Shion is skeptical.

episodes.title: Humans and Sages
episodes.overview: As the expeditioners prepare, Gabimaru asks Mei if she's sure she wants to leave the island with them.

episodes.title: Hindering and Restoration
episodes.overview: Gabimaru's group finally enters the sacred mountain, but the Tensen can see everything they're up to.

episodes.title: Two People and One Person
episodes.overview: Gantetsusai and Fuchi struggle against Tao Fa, but they seem to be enjoying themselves.

episodes.title: Chrysanthemum and Peach
episodes.overview: When Tao Fa asks Ju Fa for help, Ju Fa recalls the time they spent together.

episodes.title: Love and Karma
episodes.overview: The expeditioners work together to take on Tao Fa and Ju Fa, who have undergone Kishikai transformations.

episodes.title: Master and Student
episodes.overview: Shion and Nurugai take on Zhu Jin, but both sides lack the ability to finish the other off.

episodes.title: Ephemeralness and Fire
episodes.overview: Gabimaru recalls the days he spent with Yui. How will his battle against Rien end?

episodes.title: Endings and Beginnings
episodes.overview: As Gabimaru and his companions finish their respective battles, the additional expedition arrives.

episodes.title: The Rebirth of the King
episodes.overview: Having defeated countless enemies, obtaining wealth, fame, and everything else imaginable, the most powerful king, Grey, abruptly dies one day. He then awakens suddenly, having reincarnated in a world where magic exists. He is given the name Arthur, and begins living a second life, with loving parents.

episodes.title: The King, Under Attack
episodes.overview: The Leywin family travels to the floating city of Xyrus so that Arthur can begin his formal education in magic. The adventuring party that Reynolds and Alice belong to, the Twin Horns, accompany them as guards, when they run into something unexpected...

episodes.title: Meeting the King
episodes.overview: During the battle with the bandits, Arthur falls off of a cliff. When he awakens he encounters a mysterious beast, clad in armor. Her name is Sylvia. She helps Arthur, and seems to know where his family is, but who is she really...?

episodes.title: Saved by the King
episodes.overview: Having parted ways with Sylvia, Arthur hears a girl's scream in the woods. Upon rushing to the voice, he encounters an elf girl named Tessia, who has been captured by slavers. With Sylvia's words to "seek light in his new life" ringing in his ears, Arthur decides to challenge them by himself.

episodes.title: The King's Test
episodes.overview: Arthur arrives in the Elenoir Kingdom with Tessia, before being arrested by elvish soldiers who harbor deep resentment toward humans. Things are looking tense until Elenoir's former ruler, Virion, has him released. Arthur is then invited to the kingdom's castle. But the pain in his mana core seems to be getting worse...

episodes.title: The King's Training
episodes.overview: After being informed of a way to let Reynolds and Alice know about his survival, Arthur joins Virion and they head to a witch's house. Using special sorcery, he is able to see his parents. Witnessing the depth of their grief, Arthur decides that he will train under Virion to protect those he cares about, and to control the dangerous power growing within him.

episodes.title: The King Says Goodbye
episodes.overview: It's been three years after Arthur began his training in the Kingdom of Elenoir, having worked alongside Tessia as they both grew stronger. Arthur enlists Virion's help in order to awaken the beast that slumbers within his mana core. Then, one night, the stone Sylvia gave him begins to shine…

episodes.title: Reunited with the King
episodes.overview: Having arrived in the city of Xyrus, Arthur is thrilled to meet his younger sister, Eleanor, and to reunite with his parents. While sparring with Reynolds, he demonstrates how much he has grown. After witnessing Arthur's strength, Vincent Helstea proposes that the reborn king enroll in Xyrus Academy, a prestigious sorcery school.

episodes.title: The King Teaches
episodes.overview: Vincent and his wife Tabitha are hoping to enroll their daughter, Lilia, in Xyrus Academy. And while Lilia hopes to live up to her parents’ expectations, she has yet to awaken her mana. In the meantime, Arthur runs into a group of the academy’s students while shopping in town.

episodes.title: The King’s Defiance
episodes.overview: The Helstea Auction, which even the royals of the Sapin Kingdom attend, is opened. Vincent invites Arthur to the auction house. While among valuables on offer, Arthur discovers Sylvie has gone missing, and that she’s attracted the attention of a court sorcerer in the service of the Sapin Royal family!

episodes.title: The King’s Decision
episodes.overview: Having arrived at Xyrus Academy, Arthur displays his skills to the school’s director, Cynthia, who proves to be every bit as formidable as her position as the head of the prestigious magic academy suggests. Despite being overwhelmed, Arthur still shows his power and the two strike a deal...

episodes.title: The King’s Departure
episodes.overview: Donning a mask and taking up the alter-ego of Note, Arthur arrives at the guild to begin service as an adventurer. He has new encounters meeting Elijah, a young boy with ties to dwarven royalty, and Lucas, a half-elf member of the Sapin royal family. Afterwards, Arthur and Jasmine leave on their first adventure together. In order to protect those he cares for, the king seeks even greater power.

episodes.title: The King Begins Adventuring
episodes.overview: Arthur has been adventuring with Jasmine under the alias of Note, and they have a dangerous encounter.

episodes.title: The Princess Begins Adventuring
episodes.overview: Tessia has a mission to promote harmony between the races as an adventurer, and things aren't going smoothly.

episodes.title: The King Is Stranded
episodes.overview: Arthur, Elijah, and Lucas find themselves on a deserted island, so they try to find a way back home.

episodes.title: The King's Homecoming
episodes.overview: With quests at a standstill due to the recent mana beast issues, Arthur spends some time at home.

episodes.title: The King's Struggles
episodes.overview: Arthur and Jasmine are recruited for a dungeon raid that ends up being more dangerous than it seemed.

episodes.title: The King Is Betrayed
episodes.overview: In the lowest level of the dungeon, Arthur and his party have a horrifying encounter.

episodes.title: The King Survives
episodes.overview: An unexpected ability helps Elijah save Arthur's life, as they try to find a way out of the dungeon.

episodes.title: The King's Day in Court
episodes.overview: Note faces an inquiry at the Guild, while Lucas schemes to avoid responsibility for his betrayal.

episodes.title: The King's Gratitude
episodes.overview: Having returned home with Elijah, Arthur prepares for school at the academy and bids Jasmine farewell.

episodes.title: The King Negotiates
episodes.overview: Arthur seeks a gift to give Eleanor for her birthday, and has an interesting encounter as a result.

episodes.title: The King Celebrates
episodes.overview: It's Eleanor's birthday, and Arthur has a special gift for his little sister.

episodes.title: The King Enrolls
episodes.overview: Before enrolling in Xyrus Academy, Arthur faces the person responsible for his disastrous dungeon raid.

seasonDetails.name: Season 1
seasonDetails.overview: When a 34-year-old underachiever gets run over by a truck, his story doesn't end there. Reincarnated in a new world as an infant, Rudy will seize every opportunity to live the life he's always wanted. Armed with new friends, some freshly acquired magical abilities, and the courage to do the things he's always dreamed of, he's embarking on an epic adventure—with all of his past experience intact!

episodes.title: Jobless Reincarnation
episodes.overview: A 34-year-old unemployed recluse get hit by a truck... and wakes up as a newborn baby in a fantasy world! With loving parents, a lifetime of regrets, and a beginner’s magic textbook, he sets out to make the most of his second chance at life.

episodes.title: Master
episodes.overview: Rudy begins training with his new magic tutor and learning swordsmanship from his father. He makes rapid progress, but traumatic memories from his past life leave him too afraid to go outside. Is his second chance already doomed to failure?

episodes.title: A Friend
episodes.overview: Rudy begins to explore the village and rescues a green-haired child from a group of bullies. The two grow close practicing magic, but is there more to Rudy’s new friend than he thinks?

episodes.title: Emergency Family Meeting
episodes.overview: The Greyrat family is overjoyed when Zenith announces that she’s pregnant with a second child, but the mood takes a dour turn when Lilia reveals that she is also pregnant and Paul is the father. Will this be the end of Rudy’s happy family?

episodes.title: A Young Lady and Violence
episodes.overview: Rudy arrives in the city of Roa, where he’s supposed to spend the next five years tutoring the daughter of the local lord. His student, however, is more than he bargained for, and he’ll have to fight to start his first ever job, let alone keep it.

episodes.title: A Day Off in Roa
episodes.overview: Rudy is officially Eris’s tutor, but she doesn’t want to learn anything but magic. As Rudy struggles to get her interested in other subjects, he realizes that non-stop lessons are causing her stress and proposes a day off in the city.

episodes.title: What Lies Beyond Effort
episodes.overview: Eris’s 10th birthday is fast approaching, and her grandfather has invited nobles from across the kingdom to a dance party to celebrate. There’s just one problem: Eris can’t dance, and she’s quickly losing patience with her lessons.

episodes.title: Turning Point 1
episodes.overview: Rudy reaches his 10th birthday, and Eris and her family plan a surprise party for him. Meanwhile, the strange orb hovering over the city remains a mystery as powerful entities across the world begin to take note of it.

episodes.title: A Chance Encounter
episodes.overview: Rudy and Eris find themselves stranded in the wilds of the Demon Continent. Their only chance to survive seems to lie in Ruijerd, a warrior of the infamous Superd tribe of demons, but can he be trusted?

episodes.title: The Value of a Life and the First Job
episodes.overview: Rudeus, Eris, and Ruijerd make it to a city. They need to earn money for their journey, and decide to register as adventurers, but Superd like Ruijerd aren’t allowed inside. Rudeus has a plan, but how well will it hold up in practice?

episodes.title: Children and Warriors
episodes.overview: With their new money-making scheme in place, Dead End head out to track down a mysterious monster. Unfortunately, the job doesn’t go as smoothly as they hope, and Rudy’s plans may turn out to be a lot less safe than he thought.

episodes.title: The Woman with the Demon Eyes
episodes.overview: Dead End discovers that Ruijerd will have to pay a fortune in fees to leave the Demon Continent. As they struggle to find a way around this unexpected roadblock, Rudeus receives another vision.

episodes.title: Missed Connections
episodes.overview: Roxy arrives on the Demon Continent to begin her search for Paul's missing family. Meanwhile, Rudeus strikes a deal with smugglers to transport Ruijerd across the ocean.

episodes.title: No Such Thing as a Free Lunch
episodes.overview: Rudeus finds himself imprisoned by the beast people in Doldia Village. Will Ruijerd and Eris arrive to clear his name before he loses patience and tries to fight his way to freedom?

episodes.title: Slow Life in the Doldia Village
episodes.overview: Dead End decide to wait out the rainy season in the Doldia village. Eris befriends the chieftain's granddaughter, but her fondness for Ghislaine leads to unexpected conflict.

episodes.title: Family Squabble
episodes.overview: Rudeus, Eris, and Ruijerd arrive in the Holy Country of Millis, where Rudeus's thoughts turn to home. When the three split up for a day off, a chance encounter in an alley leads Rudeus to a shocking reunion.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.overview: In the aftermath of their disastrous reunion, Paul and Rudeus reflect on their actions and look for a way forward.

episodes.title: Separate Journeys
episodes.overview: After setting out from Millishion, Rudeus, Eris, and Ruijerd board a ship back to the Central Continent. Meanwhile, Roxy arrives in Rikarisu, where she encounters some familiar faces.

episodes.title: Route Selection
episodes.overview: Dead End finally arrives in the Shirone Kingdom on the Central Continent. Rudeus is anxious for a reunion with Roxy, but an unexpected vision from the Man-God means he may be in for more than he bargained for.

episodes.title: The Birth of My Little Sister, the Maid
episodes.overview: Rudeus is in desperate straits, imprisoned in a magic-proof dungeon by a despotic prince. But just when all seems hopeless, an unexpected visitor appears with a strange request. Will Rudeus be able to talk his way out of this one?

episodes.title: Turning Point 2
episodes.overview: Rudeus, Eris, and Ruijerd are nearing the end of their journey, but a chance encounter in a snowy mountain pass threatens to put a premature end to their adventures.

episodes.title: Dreams and Reality
episodes.overview: Rudeus and Eris finally return to Fittoa, but sudden goodbyes and unpleasant news make their homecoming bittersweet.

episodes.title: Wake Up and Take a Step
episodes.overview: Rudeus sinks into depression following Eris's departure. As he struggles to get back on his feet, the many people he's met continue their own journeys.

episodes.title: The Brokenhearted Mage
episodes.overview: Rudeus journeys to the harsh northlands in search of his lost mother. Or at least, that's what he tells himself. The scars of his parting from Eris run deep, and getting back on his feet may not be so easy.

episodes.title: The Forest in the Dead of Night
episodes.overview: Rudeus doesn't want a new party, but he still grows closer to Counter Arrow as he settles into life as a northlands adventurer. When danger rears its head, he finds himself risking it all for his new friends.

episodes.title: Abrupt Approach
episodes.overview: Things seem to be looking up for Rudeus. And when Sara asks him on a date, he decides to forget his heartbreak and start a new romance. But putting the past behind him may be easier said than done.

episodes.title: Letter of Invitation
episodes.overview: After two years of adventuring with Soldat, Rudeus is no closer to finding his mother or curing his impotence. But the sudden arrival of a seductive elf and an unexpected offer could send his life off in a whole new direction.

episodes.title: Ranoa University of Magic
episodes.overview: Following the Man-God's advice, Rudeus enrolls in school. He reunites with an old friend and meets potential new enemies, but will he find what he seeks? And what does the future hold for him and the enigmatic "Silent Fitz"?

episodes.title: I Don't Want To Die
episodes.overview: Rudeus is settling into school life and growing better acquainted with the enigmatic Silent Fitz. But when his efforts to teach Zanoba hit a roadblock, his new friend proposes a drastic solution.

episodes.title: The Kidnapping and Confinement of Beast Girls
episodes.overview: When Rudeus discovers that two of his new schoolmates have destroyed one of his precious figures, he swears revenge. But while he may be able to trounce schoolgirls in a fight, figuring out what to do with them next won't be so easy.

episodes.title: The Fiancé of Despair
episodes.overview: Love is in the air. First, a smitten classmate seeks Rudeus's help to meet the girl of his dreams. Then the beast people's mating season puts Rudeus in an awkward position—one he'll have to fight his way out of.

episodes.title: The White Mask
episodes.overview: Investigating the mass teleportation leads Rudeus to seek out his most elusive classmate: the brilliant Silent Sevenstar. But when he calls at Silent's laboratory tower, he finds a familiar face that he didn't expect—and doesn't welcome.

episodes.title: These Feelings
episodes.overview: Rudeus settles into a new routine at the university. But as time passes, Silent Fitz is increasingly in his thoughts. What does he really feel for his enigmatic classmate? And how far will he pry into a friend's secrets to find out?

episodes.title: To You
episodes.overview: Ariel confronts Sylphiette with a choice: reveal herself to Rudeus or cut ties with him forever. Determined on one last push to jog Rudeus's memory, Sylphiette invites him on a forest expedition.

episodes.title: I Want to Tell You
episodes.overview: Sylphiette reveals herself and Rudeus admits his feelings, but even that isn't enough to cure what ails him. After their heart-to-heart, Sylphiette sets out to end his problem once and for all.

episodes.title: My Dream Home
episodes.overview: Newly cured and brimming with confidence, Rudeus resolves to marry Sylphie. Just one problem: he has no idea how marriage works in this world. And when friends tell him any newlywed needs a house, he winds up with a haunted mansion.

episodes.title: Wedding Reception
episodes.overview: The newlyweds have settled into their new home. Next, custom dictates they throw a party for everyone they know. Preparing to host a crowd won't be easy. And even if they pull it off, the big day has surprises in store.

episodes.title: Afar
episodes.overview: Rudeus receives a letter from Paul. The letter explains that Norn and Aisha, Rudeus's younger sisters, have been sent to join Rudeus. Meanwhile Nanahoshi continues her research into summoning magic for a way to return to her original world.

episodes.title: Norn and Aisha
episodes.overview: Rudeus's sisters arrive with an unexpected chaperone. After catching up with an old friend, Rudeus decides it's time to send the girls to school. But convincing Norn and Aisha turns out to be more trouble than he bargained for.

episodes.title: My Older Brother's Feelings
episodes.overview: Norn shuts herself in her dorm room and refuses to attend classes. Haunted by the specter of his past life, Rudeus sets out to solve his sister's problems, only to discover that he is the cause.

episodes.title: Turning Point 3
episodes.overview: Life is looking up for Rudeus. His sisters are settling in, and he has plenty of time for friends and family... until an announcement from Sylphie and an unexpected letter upend his idyllic school life.

episodes.title: Desert Journey
episodes.overview: With Nanahoshi's help, Rudeus gains a way to shorten his journey, but he and Elinalise will still need to hurry if they hope to return before Sylphie gives birth. Their first obstacle: the harsh desert of Begaritt and its monstrous denizens.

episodes.title: Into the Labyrinth
episodes.overview: Rudeus and Elinalise reach Rapan and soon reunite with Paul, only to learn that a deadly labyrinth has claimed both Zenith and Roxy. The fruits of Rudeus's studies offer a last, faint hope to reach his mother and his mentor in time.

episodes.title: Magic Circle to the Sixth Stratum
episodes.overview: With Roxy's rescue, the search for Zenith resumes in earnest. Rudeus reconnects with his mentor amid the perils of the labyrinth. But why does she seem a little more awkward around him than before?

episodes.title: Parents
episodes.overview: The rescue party reaches the heart of the Teleporter Labyrinth and confronts its guardian. But when the monster shrugs off Rudeus's magic, they realize they may have bitten off more than they can chew.

episodes.title: Let's Go Home
episodes.overview: Roxy makes a desperate move to pull Rudeus out of his depression. As the group journeys home, both of them must face their feelings and negotiate the consequences.

episodes.title: Succession
episodes.overview: Rudeus arrives home, frantic that something may have gone wrong in his absence. But the conversations waiting for him may become disasters in their own right. How can he introduce a new wife to a family still reeling from Paul's death?

episodes.title: Burn Bright, Mad Dog
episodes.overview: Ghislaine takes Eris to train under the Sword God, but Eris's brash attitude angers the other disciples.

episodes.title: Howl, Mad Dog
episodes.overview: Nina continues to eye Eris as a rival, but training with masters of other styles sparks new discoveries.

episodes.title: Life Back at Home
episodes.overview: Rudeus starts a new life with Roxy and Sylphiette, but not all his friends approve of his second marriage.

episodes.title: A King-Class Water Mage
episodes.overview: Fearful of losing more loved ones, Rudeus begs Roxy to teach him a more potent form of magic.

episodes.title: Celebrations
episodes.overview: Rudeus attends Cliff and Elinalise's wedding and goes shopping for his sisters' birthday presents.

episodes.title: Another Domestic Disaster?
episodes.overview: Rudeus accompanies Roxy on a bodyguard mission and runs into an unexpected face from his past.

episodes.title: Phase Four
episodes.overview: Following a successful summoning experiment, Nanahoshi offers Rudeus a reward.

episodes.title: The Flying Fortress
episodes.overview: Rudeus seeks an audience with the hero Perugius, hoping to find a cure for his mother's condition.

episodes.title: Lament
episodes.overview: Nanahoshi contracts an ancient disease. Seeing her lose hope, Rudeus races to find help.

episodes.title: An Audience with an Immortal Demon King
episodes.overview: Rudeus and friends locate Kishirika, only to be captured along with her by the guards of a warlike Demon King.

episodes.title: Turning Point 4
episodes.overview: Rudeus receives a puzzling message in his dreams. But before he can act on it, a strange visitor appears.

episodes.title: An End and a Beginning
episodes.overview: Rudeus's strange guest recounts his future and reveals the cause of all his misfortunes.

episodes.title: The Diary
episodes.overview: In a future that could have been, Rudeus crumbles under the weight of loss.

episodes.title: Resolve
episodes.overview: Having read one possible future, Rudeus takes action to avoid it and protect the people he loves.

episodes.title: Failed... Hero
episodes.overview: Due to certain circumstances, ordinary high school student Misumi Makoto is summoned to another world to become a Hero... at least, he was supposed to be one. However, despised by the Goddess for a ridiculous reason, Makoto is banished to the barren Wasteland. At his wit's end, Makoto wanders the wasteland, where he begins to make friends with Highland orc girl Emma. However, when Makoto learns that she's going to be sacrificed to the greater dragon Shen...

episodes.title: Black Spider of Disaster
episodes.overview: Makoto forms a favorable contract with greater dragon Shin. Shin takes him to her demiplane, another world that exists within her mist. Blessed with fertile lands and hidden from the Goddess, Makoto develops the demiplane along with the Highland orcs who have settled there. Meanwhile, outside the demiplane, the Black Spider of Disaster driven to madness by her eternal hunger closes in on the demiplane.

episodes.title: Human Shock
episodes.overview: Makoto is entered into a contract with the Black Spider of Disaster while he's unconscious. Despite his confusion, he gives names to Shin and the Black Spider of Disaster. Meanwhile, various demihumans including the elder dwarves begin settling in the demiplane. Surrounded by demihumans, Makoto begins to miss humans and heads to a human town. However, he finds armed humans waiting for him! Why would they do this?!

episodes.title: Too Late
episodes.overview: In the human town of Zetsuya, Makoto and company meet a girl named Rinon who is searching for her missing sister. That night, they're attacked at the inn. They learn Rinon's sister Toa is being held captive because of her debt. As Makoto nearly loses his cool for certain reasons, Tomoe and Mio go to rescue Toa instead. However, a single man stands in their way.

episodes.title: The Greedy Wagon's Journey
episodes.overview: Makoto leaves behind the destroyed town of Zetsuya and travels towards a new town with Toa, Rinon, and other adventurers. While defeating many monsters on the road, the group safely arrives in Tsige. Sorry to see Toa and her party go, Makoto suggests they throw one last party. During the party, Makoto hears an unsettling rumor about the Rembrandt Trading Company, the client of his first job...

episodes.title: The Melancholy of Handsome Middle-Aged Men
episodes.overview: Makoto's party accepts the Rembrandt Trading Company job. They've already acquired the necessary materials, and their first job as adventurers seems to be going well... But trading company owner Patrick Rembrandt distrusts Makoto, as he lacks any kind of adventuring record. Furthermore, Makoto seeks to join the merchants' guild, where two tests await him.

episodes.title: Wondrous Medicine Production
episodes.overview: In order to save Rembrandt's wife and children from the cursed disease afflicting them, Makoto and Hazal get to work producing the wondrous medicine known as ambrosia. After administering the medicine, Makoto prays for their recovery and leaves Rembrandt's mansion. Tomoe and Mio meet up with Makoto after he completes the job. They're attacked by a group of strangers who have been following them since they left the inn...

episodes.title: Demiplane Ranking
episodes.overview: Having completed the job for Rembrandt, Makoto is relaxing in the demiplane, but there's a new problem. The Highland orc and lizardmen warriors Makoto and his companions have been training have lost their confidence. Tomoe announces the Demiplane Ranking, a series of one-on-one combats between warriors of all species in order to raise their morale!

episodes.title: Eat or Be Eaten
episodes.overview: A feast is held to celebrate the establishment of Kuzunoha Trading Company in the hyuman town. After getting better acquainted with the residents of the demiplane, Makoto sneaks off to practice archery. However, a very flustered Tomoe and Mio show up. Mio suddenly bursts into tears, and Makoto struggles to understand the situation. Just then, Tomoe says something unbelievable!

episodes.title: Hidden Ogre Village
episodes.overview: Makoto and Mio visit Tinarak Forest in order to acquire ambrosia flowers for the Kuzunoha Trading Company, but they are attacked by Aqua and Eris, the forest ogres protecting the flowers. Distracted by a deranged Mio and the adventurers who happened to show up, Makoto finds himself cornered. With Tomoe's help, Makoto and Mio escape their predicament. However, at the forest ogre village they visited to negotiate a deal, they get dragged into yet another incident...

episodes.title: Goodbye
episodes.overview: A mysterious explosion occurs in the demiplane, and Tomoe collapses. Though Makoto is unsettled by the sudden events, he heads to the site of the explosion in order to treat the wounded. Makoto is shocked to learn the denizens of the demiplane were harmed in the explosion. Meanwhile, he learns the truth from the hyuman memory that enters his mind! What will Makoto do once he discovers the selfish actions they took?!

episodes.title: Guided by the Moon...
episodes.overview: Makoto departs for the academy... at least, that was the plan. However, the goddess transports Makoto into the middle of a battle between hyumans and demons. There he is attacked by the strongest hyuman adventurer Sofia Bulga and greater dragon Mitsurugi. Having sided with the demons, Sofia and Mitsurugi believe Makoto is the goddess' disciple and attack mercilessly. Facing a crisis, Makoto musters the last strength he has remaining and activates his magic--

episodes.title: What? Moon over the Ruined Castle?
episodes.overview: Mikoto and Shiki are making their way to Rotsgard Academy in hopes of opening a new store. Meanwhile, back in the demiplane, everyone is helping Mio practice her cooking skills by taste-testing her dishes.

episodes.title: The Heroes Are a Couple of Beauties
episodes.overview: We meet one of Misumi Makoto's classmates back on earth, who also has a curious encounter with a certain goddess who presides over a certain isekai. She and one other are sent there as heroes to help the hyumans defeat the demons.

episodes.title: Stellar Wars
episodes.overview: Hibiki and Tomoki's parties prepare for the attack on Fort Stella (the one Makoto ended up being somewhat involved in against his will). The two human heroes couldn't be more different, posing challenges beyond the simple difficulty of facing the demons.

episodes.title: Why Am I a Teacher?!
episodes.overview: Makoto finally arrives in Rotsgard, but is shocked to find that he's somehow ended up registered to take a teacher's exam instead of one for students. On the way there, he crosses paths with some haughty students of the school...

episodes.title: The Lesson Will Now Begin
episodes.overview: Makoto starts planning his curriculum and class size now that he's employed at Rotsgard Academy. He wants to teach students to expand their use of elemental magic, but his first class seems to think that's simply impossible.

episodes.title: Becoming a Three-Star Chef
episodes.overview: Makoto is finally able to open his new shop in Rotsgard, but convincing staff to work there rather than Tsige is a bit of a challenge. He later has a talk with Eva about this world's view of marriage, which doesn't sit well with him.

episodes.title: New Member Audition
episodes.overview: Makoto returns to the demiplane to check out his new house, which has finally completed construction. He arrives to find that the weather is unseasonably hot, and the source of the problem might be his fault.

episodes.title: The Notorious Beautiful Sisters
episodes.overview: Makoto had a busy but fun time in the demiplane. After finishing his business, he returns to Rotsgard with Shiki. Meanwhile, at Rotsgard Academy, Shifu and Yuno Rembrandt have returned to school and will attend a lecture with transfer student Karen Force.

episodes.title: The Perverted Dragon
episodes.overview: Lime sets out to investigate hyuman experiments that are secretly being carried out in Rotsgard. He ends up being captured by an underground organization along with Eva. After that, the two manage to escape and meet up with Shin and the others.

episodes.title: Watch as I Improve the World
episodes.overview: Shin and company begin full-scale action to destroy the underground organization with demon general Rona's help. The group discovers that the mastermind is Bright, an instructor at Rotsgard Academy. Bright's willingness to make sacrifices angers Makoto.

episodes.title: Summer of Growth and New Skills
episodes.overview: It's summer vacation for Rotsgard Academy. Makoto spends his time doing miscellaneous work and learning magic. One day it's decided he will have a mock battle against the wingkin. Makoto braces himself against his powerful enemies who are undefeated.

episodes.title: Attack of the Giant Monsters
episodes.overview: One day near summer's end, the highland orcs are attacked by wolves and bears while exploring the forest. After hearing the news, Makoto goes to the forest in an attempt to make peace between them, but the bear he meets looks upon him with hostility.

episodes.title: The Very Busy Academy Festival
episodes.overview: The academy festival is fast approaching. Shinai, a temple priest, arranges a meeting with Makoto on short notice. Shinai informs Makoto about rumors concerning the medicine being sold at the shop and offers Makoto a proposal to help dispel them.

episodes.title: I'm Not a Fan of High Society
episodes.overview: Makoto attends a luncheon on the second day of the festival and is approached by Sairitsu, an official with the Laurel Commonwealth. She suspects Makoto may be from another world because of the foreign characters on the Kuzunoha Trading Company's sign.

episodes.title: A Fierce Tournament
episodes.overview: Students take on the individual competition in the school festival's highlight event, the combat tournament. Due to a nobleman plot, they are forced to face off against their peers. Jin advances to the finals and faces off against Ilumgand Hopleys.

episodes.title: A Certain Student's Secret
episodes.overview: Due to the incident with Zara, Makoto decides to join the demons, and after witnessing the fighting tournament, he decides to leave Rotsgard. The next day, Jin and his friends advance to the finals of the team competition and face a team led by Ilumgand.

episodes.title: Mutation Hazard
episodes.overview: Ilumgand was transformed into a monster. Jin and Abelia launch an attack to stop him. However, their attacks have no effect, and they lose their fighting spirit and energy in the face of an enemy stronger than ever.

episodes.title: Fall of the Academy City
episodes.overview: Rotsgard's turmoil continues. Numerous mutants have appeared in the city and Jin and his friends attempt to subjugate them. Meanwhile, Mio, who has been ordered by Makoto to protect the shelter, detects a strange smell from Makoto during her mission.

episodes.title: The Unruly Merchant
episodes.overview: The mutant turmoil shows no signs of ending. At the evacuation center, people who've transformed into new mutants have appeared, anxiety and fatigue have reached their peak. To change the situation, Misumi's group joins the mutant subjugation force.

episodes.title: The Utterly Hateable Good-for-Nothing
episodes.overview: Using the mutant disturbance as a decoy the demon army advances on the Kingdom of Limia and the Empire of Gritonia. The hyuman army tries to intercept them, but are quickly outnumbered and overpowered. The two great powers are on the verge of collapse.

episodes.title: The Heroes Fight Bravely
episodes.overview: Tomoe, Mio, and the residents of the demiplane are ordered by Makoto to take back Kaleneon, and enter enemy territory. Meanwhile, in the Gritonia Empire, Tomoki and his friends head to the battlefield, where they encounter Sofia standing in their way.

episodes.title: Fight On, Hero!
episodes.overview: Makoto is shaken by the revelation that the hero he meets on the battlefield is his high school senior, Hibiki Otonashi. Unable to dwell on it, Makoto enters a battle with Io to whom he suggests the demons retreat, in order to avoid a pointless battle

episodes.title: Rival Revenge Match
episodes.overview: Sofia suddenly barges into the battle between Makoto and Io. Having longed for a rematch with Makoto, Sofia launches a fierce attack on her nemesis as soon as she steps onto the battlefield. Despite being outnumbered, Makoto appears unfazed.

episodes.title: Sorcerer vs. Draconid
episodes.overview: Outside Limia's royal castle, a fierce battle between Shiki and Mitsurugi unfolds. Meanwhile, inside the castle, the battle between Makoto and Sofia continues. Sofia, at a loss, unleashes her secret weapon.

episodes.title: Party Beneath the Moonlight
episodes.overview: After the battle in Limia, Makoto returns to the demiplane where he is welcomed by Tomoe, Mio and the residents of the demiplane. After a short celebration Makoto returns to Rotsgard to wipe out the remaining mutants, ending the days-long turmoil.

shieldhero.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero

seasonDetails.name: Season 1
seasonDetails.overview: The Four Cardinal Heroes are a group of ordinary men from modern-day Japan summoned to the kingdom of Melromarc to become its saviors. Melromarc is a country plagued by the Waves of Catastrophe that have repeatedly ravaged the land and brought disaster to its citizens for centuries. The four heroes are respectively bestowed a sword, spear, bow, and shield to vanquish these Waves. Naofumi Iwatani, an otaku, becomes cursed with the fate of being the "Shield Hero." Armed with only a measly shield, Naofumi is belittled and ridiculed by his fellow heroes and the kingdom's people due to his weak offensive capabilities and lackluster personality. As the Waves approach the kingdom, Naofumi and Raphtalia must fight for the survival of the kingdom and protect the people of Melromarc from their ill-fated future.

seasonDetails.name: Season 2
seasonDetails.overview: With another Wave happening in a week, Naofumi Iwatani and his party have no time to waste. However, when bat familiars raid Lurolona Village and the Wave countdown comes to a halt, the Four Cardinal Heroes reconvene with the queen, Mirelia Q Melromarc, for a quick briefing. The queen presumes that the odd occurrences are linked to the Spirit Tortoise—a threatening creature that has awakened from its slumber, back to cause havoc once again. A plan to put the Spirit Tortoise to rest is devised—but out of the four men, only the cursed Shield Hero agrees to help.

seasonDetails.name: Season 3
seasonDetails.overview: After defeating the Spirit Tortoise, Naofumi has no time for rest. An attack from the next Guardian Beast is imminent, but the three other Cardinal Heroes have gone missing. So, Naofumi and his party set out to search for the legendary trio.

seasonDetails.name: Season 4
seasonDetails.overview: As Naofumi prepares for the Phoenix’s return, assassins from Q’ten Lo target Raphtalia, mistaking her for a throne usurper. To resolve the conflict, Naofumi journeys to Siltvelt, where he is hailed as a demi-human savior, but not all welcome him. In politically volatile Q’ten Lo, Raphtalia becomes a revolutionary symbol. Amid rising chaos, can Naofumi unite his allies and guide them to salvation?

episodes.title: The Shield Hero
episodes.overview: College student Iwatani Naofumi is reading a book titled "The Records of the Four Cardinal Weapons" in the library when he is suddenly summoned to another world and told he has to save the world as the Shield Hero, one of the Four Cardinal Heroes. And one morning, he finds all his money and equipment gone.

episodes.title: The Slave Girl
episodes.overview: Naofumi follows the slave merchant to his store, where he looks for a partner to act as his sword. But all he has the money to buy is a diseased demi-human girl named Raphtalia, whom he then forces into an incredibly harsh battle.

episodes.title: Wave of Catastrophe
episodes.overview: Naofumi has obtained a whole load of abilities and skills, and his teamwork with Raphtalia is reaching perfection, too. To prepare for the incoming Wave, he upgrades their equipment and heads to the dragon hourglass to find out exactly when it will arrive. But there, he runs into Motoyasu and the other heroes once again.

episodes.title: Lullaby at Dawn
episodes.overview: The Wave is gone, but Naofumi's relief is short-lived as Motoyasu challenges him to a duel in the middle of the celebratory banquet held in Melromarc Castle. Motoyasu insists that owning a slave is unbecoming for a hero and that Naofumi free Raphtalia at once.

episodes.title: Filo
episodes.overview: After Aultcray reluctantly offers Naofumi a paltry reward, he heads to the slave merchant to redo the slave crest as per Raphtalia's wishes. He also buys a monster egg there, which hatches a few days later and gives him a new party member. Meanwhile, Myne shows up in Lute Village, where they're staying.

episodes.title: A New Comrade
episodes.overview: The mysterious girl that showed up out of nowhere was actually Filo. She's a filolial queen with an advanced transformation ability, and she can even take human form thanks to it. However, her clothes get ripped every time she transforms, meaning Naofumi has to get her some magic clothes if he doesn't want to go broke. The party leaves on a new adventure to gather the materials required.

episodes.title: The Savior of the Heavenly Fowl
episodes.overview: After hearing of a village that's in immediate need of herbicide, Naofumi and his party head there to do business. The village has been overrun by plants that have turned into monsters, and its residents were forced to abandon it. These plants can even take root in humans, and apparently Motoyasu is the one who released them into the wild.

episodes.title: Curse Shield
episodes.overview: After hearing of a village in the East that's being ravaged by an epidemic, Naofumi and his party head there to deliver medicine. The epidemic was caused by the corpse of a dragon that had been killed a month before and left there to rot. Naofumi's party accepts a job request to clean the corpse and head to the mountains where it lies.

episodes.title: Melty
episodes.overview: In the Eastern village, Naofumi meets a girl named Melty. She instantly becomes friends with Filo and then requests to accompany the party on their journey. It seems she got separated from her guards. They travel together for a while, but when they reach the capital, they find...

episodes.title: In the Midst of Turmoil
episodes.overview: After refusing to hear Melty out, Naofumi switches to planning for the next Wave. When a bunch of young soldiers ask to join his party, he agrees, but on a certain condition. At the same time, he also tries to upgrade Raphtalia's class after she hits the level cap, but all he receives is harassment.

episodes.title: Catastrophe Returns
episodes.overview: Naofumi faces another Wave, this time in a remote village. With the help of the soldiers who volunteered to join him, he's able to secure the safety of the villagers, but the Wave shows no signs of letting up. He heads to fight with the other heroes, only to find a giant ghost ship floating in the sky.

episodes.title: The Raven Invader
episodes.overview: A mysterious woman showed up out of nowhere and destroyed the second Soul Eater in a single blow. She then proclaimed the start of the "true battle of the wave" and blew away the other three heroes when they attacked her. With Naofumi's party proving ineffective as well, he decided to use the Rage Shield one more time.

episodes.title: The Devil of the Shield
episodes.overview: Naofumi foils the attempt to take Melty's life and fights off the royal knights, but he's then framed for abducting Melty and killing several knights, so the party is forced to go on the run. With security tightened and checkpoints everywhere, the party receives a further blow that only makes things even worse.

episodes.title: Everlasting Memory
episodes.overview: Due to Myne recklessly starting a forest fire, Naofumi and his party are forced to flee to a village at the base of the mountain. However, it won't be easy to break through the knights' net. Melty suggests going to a noble she knows for help, and it just so happens that Raphtalia's past is linked to his domain.

episodes.title: Raphtalia
episodes.overview: Raphtalia corners Idol with vengeance in her eyes, her bloodthirsty blade reaching for his throat. Naofumi's words bring her back to her senses momentarily, but when Idol attacks her once again...

episodes.title: Filolial Queen
episodes.overview: As Naofumi and his party try to get the weakened kids to safety, Tyrant attacks them. Once Naofumi realizes that he's actually after Filo, he hatches a plan to lure him outside the city, but they can't even put a scratch on its massive body.

episodes.title: A Promise Made
episodes.overview: Fitoria tells Naofumi that she'll kill all Four Cardinal Heroes if they don't get back on the same page. She even takes Melty hostage, but Naofumi continues to refuse. Understanding where he's coming from, Fitoria instead proposes a one-on-one duel with Filo.

episodes.title: A Conspiracy Linked
episodes.overview: Naofumi decides to go straight up to the checkpost in order to talk it out with the other heroes. But there, he finds the one guy least likely to listen to him, Motoyasu, who attacks Naofumi without bothering to listen to what he has to say. Why could Motoyasu be so intent on killing Naofumi, more than ever before?

episodes.title: The Four Cardinal Heroes
episodes.overview: The Pope holds in his hands the ultimate weapon, which possesses the properties of all four cardinal weapons. Faced with its attack skill, "Judgment," and its powerful defensive force field, Naofumi and gang are rendered helpless. As the crisis worsens, Motoyasu, who is now in line to be punished as a "fake" hero, makes a surprising decision.

episodes.title: Battle of Good and Evil
episodes.overview: Naofumi and gang stay on the attack despite being trapped in the Pope's Great Cathedral, but its sacred subspace nullifies his Curse Shield, leaving them one step short. Naofumi turns to another, newly unlocked Curse Shield, but the dragon's wrath threatens to swallow his mind whole.

episodes.title: Naofumi's Triumphant Return
episodes.overview: After Naofumi survives thanks to Mirelia's help, she comes to visit him and tells him the truth behind the summoning of the heroes and the discrimination against the Shield Hero. She also promises to clear his name, and holds a trial for Aultcray and Myne's crimes.

episodes.title: Four Heroes Council
episodes.overview: After being unable to for so long, Naofumi finally gets to upgrade his party's classes. He then takes part in a meeting of the Four Cardinal Heroes, held under the guise of a celebratory banquet. There, he learns of the existence of a bonus stage, with increased XP earnings. Meanwhile, Raphtalia gets into a fight at the party.

episodes.title: Cal Mira Archipelago
episodes.overview: On the ship to Cal Mira, Naofumi once again runs into L'arc, who keeps throwing him off. However, the strange man's friendly nature shines through, and Naofumi quickly takes a liking to him. After having a fun time grinding levels and a lively meal, Naofumi feels happy and fulfilled for the first time in this world.

episodes.title: Guardians of Another World
episodes.overview: Melromarc brings a large fleet to fight the Wave out at sea. While the queen takes charge and leads the operation well, the other three heroes prove useless yet again, leaving Naofumi to do it all alone. Later, he gets help from L'arc and Therese to fend off the monsters, but then...

episodes.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero
episodes.overview: It turns out that Glass, like L'arc, is also a hero from other world. Naofumi barely fights off their combo attacks and then corners Glass in a one-on-one battle, but is then faced with an all-important question: does he truly wish to protect this world?

episodes.title: A New Roar
episodes.overview: Mysterious monsters appear as Naofumi is preparing for the next Wave. At the same time they show up, the Wave countdown stops. The Queen summons the Four Cardinal Heroes, and tells them that the Spirit Tortoise has revived.

episodes.title: Footprints of the Spirit Tortoise
episodes.overview: The leaders of all the nations’ militaries gather in the Spirit Tortoise Kingdom. Naofumi is there as well, and promises to offer his help as one of the heroes. But just before they decide on a plan, a mysterious woman appears…

episodes.title: Shaking Land
episodes.overview: The Spirit Tortoise begins its march once more, appearing at the border of the kingdom bearing its name. Naofumi volunteers to lure away its familiars while the army tries to bring it to the mountains. The Spirit Tortoise’s familiar, Ost, fights alongside the humans…

episodes.title: Ruins in the Fog
episodes.overview: The Spirit Tortoise’s head was cut off, but Ost, its familiar, is still alive. It could revive at any moment. The allied armies need to get back into fighting shape, and fast. Naofumi makes the risky move of heading onto the Tortoise’s back with only a small group, and tries to find its true weak spot.

episodes.title: Ost Hourai
episodes.overview: Naofumi is met by L’Arc, Glass, and Therese. They’re after the person who broke the Spirit Tortoise’s seal and is controlling it. L’Arc proposes teaming up again…

episodes.title: Racing to Catch Up
episodes.overview: Fitoria appears when the Spirit Tortoise revives, and with her help, Naofumi attempts to destroy its heart and cut off its head at the same time. L’Arc arrives as well, but all of them are helpless before Kyo’s overwhelming power.

episodes.title: Infinite Labyrinth
episodes.overview: Naofumi wakes up in a strange prison to find him and his party at level 1, and Filo missing. They start to raise their levels in order to escape, but things quickly turn against them when a dangerous monster suddenly appears…

episodes.title: A Parting in the Snow
episodes.overview: Naofumi’s party heads for the Dragon Hourglass of Mikakage, in order to get to Sikul, the country that summoned Kizuna. Along the way, he sells rare healing items to make a hefty profit. He hears a rumor about a genius mage…

episodes.title: Humming Fairy
episodes.overview: Naofumis party is teleported to Sikul, where Kizuna introduces the Vassal Weapon Hero, Ethnobalt. He soys he can use a piece of Raphtalia's hair and Naofumis blood as a catalyst that can create a shikigami to find her. He creates the shikigami, and they find.

episodes.title: Katana Hero
