episodes.title: Legend Leaf
episodes.overview: The Harvest Festival is coming to an end. Iruma and his friends have managed to obtain the Seed of Beginnings and the Vase of Endings. But they have no idea how to make the Legend Leaf bloom. Lead then remembers one of their old lessons with Suzie and remembers a certain spell... Iruma and Lead have exhausted their energy and mana at this point. Will they be able to successfully make the Legend Leaf bloom in the little time that they have?! Finally, the results are announced. Who will be the student who gets the title of Young King?

episodes.title: Welcome Back
episodes.overview: The Legend Leaf exploded in the sky and bloomed into beautiful flower petals. While everyone's in a celebrating mood, the award ceremony begins. Those who did excellently in the event, those who ended up forfeiting... How did all of the members of the Misfit Class do? Were they all able to reach the rank they needed to?! All of the mentors also are reunited with their students. How will the mentors respond to their students' performances during the Harvest Festival?

episodes.title: The Instructors' Banquet
episodes.overview: The night that the Harvest Festival ended, the instructors of Babyls got together at a pub to celebrate. Kalego usually never goes to these outings, but Balam catches him and forces him to go. Robin is getting ahead of himself as usual and the group even talks about Kalego's days as a newbie instructor. What is the most important thing about being an instructor at Babyls? We also get to see what happened to Ocho after he escaped into the jungle after the Harvest Festival.

episodes.title: Bad Company / Heartfelt Cooking Class
episodes.overview: Iruma goes over to Lead's house after getting a brand new gaming console. While they're playing games, Lead's older sister Shakky suddenly bursts into Lead's room, and she seems to be in a really bad mood... Ameri and Iruma end up making homemade cookies together. But apparently, neither one of them has ever cooked something properly in their lives. They are an absolute mess in the kitchen and even Opera seems to have some trouble dealing with them...

episodes.title: Words for My Friends
episodes.overview: Sullivan invited Bachiko to a huge breakfast to thank her for having contributed to the victory of her darling grandson, but also to inform her about a very worrying situation involving Iruma. After that, Iruma and Clara are invited to Asmondeus mansion where Iruma feels tremendous guilt for keeping his secret hidden from his friends. Back at school, the Misfits prepare for the Music Festival, their last chance to get all remaining Gimel's promoted to Dalet.

episodes.title: The Other Demon in the Misfit Class
episodes.overview: The Misfit Class find out they need to compete in the Music Festival and find out they had another student.

episodes.title: A Challenge to the Thirteen
episodes.overview: The Misfit Class try to figure out what kind of performance they're going to do for the Music Festival.

episodes.title: The Essence of a Dem-dol
episodes.overview: The Misfit Class decide to do the Hell Dance at the Music Festival and Kalego coaches Iruma and Purson.

episodes.title: We Can't See Him, But...
episodes.overview: Iruma wants to have a chat with Purson.

episodes.title: Let's Have a Chat
episodes.overview: Purson has disappeared, but Iruma doesn’t give up and decides to talk with him.

episodes.title: The Music Festival: Showtime!!
episodes.overview: Suzuki Iruma and all thirteen students of the Misfit Class must perform to reach Rank 4 at the Music Festival.

episodes.title: Lilith's Carpet
episodes.overview: Iruma and the rest of the Misfit Class perform their rendition of "Lilith's Carpet."

episodes.title: Victory Salute
episodes.overview: Iruma and the Misfit Class learn the results of the Music Festival and Purson has a chat with his father.

episodes.title: Behind Those Eyes
episodes.overview: Asmodeus goes to fetch something from the club room and runs into someone unexpected.

episodes.title: Triple Love Squad
episodes.overview: Iruma and Asmodeus spend the day together having fun.

episodes.title: Best Friend Meeting / Lead's Flirting Meeting
episodes.overview: Iruma explains friendship to the class, while Lead seeks advice on getting closer to Elizabetta.

episodes.title: One-Year Distance and One-Centimeter Distance
episodes.overview: Ameri goes to the Deviculum and contemplates her current distance with Iruma.

episodes.title: Suzuki Iruma's Exorcibration
episodes.overview: Iruma-kun celebrates his birthday for the first time in the netherworld.

episodes.title: Infiltrate the Teacher Dorms! / A New Member Joins the Girls?!
episodes.overview: Iruma visits the teacher dorms and Naphula joins the girl squad.

episodes.title: The Laws of the Netherworld Dictate That One Takes After Their Master / Even Among Those Who Are Close...
episodes.overview: Jazz tries to deal with his familiar and Lead teaches Asmodeus how to play video games.

episodes.title: A Misfit Casual Gathering / Netherworld Devotee
episodes.overview: The Misfit Class has a party at Iruma's home and then Iruma helps Opera perform their daily duties.

episodes.title: The Great Heroes Gather
episodes.overview: The Thirteen Crowns discuss their future and nominate candidates for the next Demon King.

episodes.title: Give the Youth All the Nutrients They Need / Crossing the Sunbeams Shining Through the Trees
episodes.overview: The Dinner of the Thirteen Crowns occurs and then Iruma, Asmodeus, and Clara contemplate being second-years.

episodes.title: The Dem-dol Games
episodes.overview: The Dem-dols Games begins.

episodes.title: Team Devimuse
episodes.overview: Team Devimuse loses a member and gets an unlikely substitute.

episodes.title: The Tycoon and the Jewel
episodes.overview: Both Gyari and Kuromu make shocking announcements at the Dem-dol Games.

episodes.title: The Proud Songstress
episodes.overview: The Dem-Dol Games finally come to a close.

episodes.title: The Road to the Demon King
episodes.overview: Iruma goes to visit Sabro to find out more about Demon Kings.

episodes.title: The Most Extravagant Farewell Party
episodes.overview: The new school year finally begins at Babyls.
